Detective Kang Hee Sik begins to work with the 3 women on the drug case. Detective Kang Hee Sik also becomes attracted to Kang Nam Soon.

dramas.name: Let's Make a New Start
dramas.summary: In this modern day Cinderella story, the protagonist, who works in a department store as a salesperson, makes dreams come true both in work and love by overcoming obstacles in life.

dramas.name: Individual Circumstances
dramas.summary: Ha Yeon Woo was once the toast of Chungmuro – Seoul, South Korea's answer to America's Hollywood. As a maverick young movie director, his debut film was a massive hit for both filmgoers and critics alike. But after this auspicious start, he fell into a lengthy slump. He is now listless and unsure if he is really cut out to be a top movie director after all.One day, he meets Sung Woo Jae, a famous fiction writer who he once knew – but has not spoken to for some time. Sung Woo Jae also has demons, however. His first love ended in sadness, and he took solace in his writing, eventually going on to become a prolific web-based novel author. Their meeting ignites a passionate romance that burns as bright as the flames of war. Will this relationship heal Sung Woo Jae's wounds – and lift Ha Yeon Woo out of his slump?

dramas.name: Delivery Man
dramas.summary: The story of a taxi driver who grants the last wishes of ghosts.

dramas.name: Life After One Minute
dramas.summary: The story of Lee Segye who can see one minute into the future and Ha Nabi who caught his eye.

dramas.name: Secret Woman
dramas.summary: A drama about a woman who loses her sight due to her husband and his lover and falls into 'Locked-In Syndrome' (conscious general paralysis) getting involved with an heiress who has everything and comes out for truth and revenge.

dramas.name: Vigilante
dramas.summary: Vigilante tells the story of the journey of a young man bent on seeking revenge after witnessing his mother's brutal murder as a child. Since the traumatic event, Kim Ji Yong has dedicated himself to martial arts, becoming an exemplary student at the police academy. Upon his mother's attacker's release, Ji Yong catches him in the midst of another assault, setting him on a path of taking justice into his own hands, garnering unwelcome attention from the media and police.  Refusing to give up his mission, Jiyong finds himself assuming the role of a vigilante, correcting the wrongs of repeat offenders.

dramas.name: Queenmaker
dramas.summary: Strategy. Influence. Corruption. An unlikely pair of accomplished women joins forces to go up against a powerful conglomerate for the mayorship of Seoul.

dramas.name: Mask Girl
dramas.summary: An office worker who is insecure about her looks becomes a masked internet personality by night --- until a chain of ill-

dramas.name: Celebrity
dramas.summary: Fame. Money. Power. One young woman fights to become the next hottest celebrity in the glamorous yet scandalous world of influencers in Seoul.

dramas.name: Song of the Bandits
dramas.summary: In the lawless land of Gando, fierce bandits will stop at nothing to fight for their precious homeland and loved ones — even if it means life or death. This Korean Western drama stars Kim Nam-gil, Seohyun, Yoo Jae-myung, Lee Hyun-wook and Lee Ho-jung.

dramas.name: My Heart Is Beating
dramas.summary: A romance drama about a semi-human vampire named Sun Woo Hyul, who failed to become a human by a day out of 100 years, and a woman Joo In Hae, who doesn't have a single human decency, starting to live together and finding true warmth.

dramas.name: Behind Your Touch
dramas.summary: Ye Boon, who has always dreamed of becoming a vet in the small town of Mujin in Chungjeong-do, is instead stuck doing the nitty-gritty work to make ends meet, like delivering calves and vaccinating halibuts. Then one day, she was given psychometric powers during one of her visits to a cow farm. She encounters the passionate detective Jang Yul, who mistakes her for a pervert and attempts to tackle her. Subsequently, Jang Yul relies on Ye Boon and her powers to solve his cases, from petty crimes to serial murder. The two grow closer as they solve each case, one by one.

dramas.name: Doona!
dramas.summary: A college student navigates life and school while dealing with a unique predicament — he's living with a beautiful former K-pop sensation.

dramas.name: Duty After School
dramas.summary: A science fiction thriller that depicts all students across the country fighting against unidentified objects ahead of the CSAT and fighting for extra points.

dramas.name: The Good Bad Mother
dramas.summary: A single mom who has been widowed at a young age, Yeong-soon runs a pig farm, and raises her son Kang-ho by herself. She becomes a "bad mother" - hard on her son because she doesn't want him to grow up penniless nor powerless. Thanks to her discipline, Kang-ho grows up to be a prominent prosecutor, but loses his memory due to an unfortunate accident and becomes a 7-year-old again. Young-soon decides to become a "bad mother" again for Kang-ho in this comforting and touching comedy series that tracks the journey of recovery between mother and son.

dramas.name: Unconditional, Desire
dramas.summary: Unconditional, Desire tells the story of a woman who sacrificed her life for her younger sister, but after losing her sister in a shocking accident, she enters a chaebol family with a desire for blood-red revenge.

dramas.name: Family
dramas.summary: A spy comedy drama about an NIS Black agent husband disguised as an ordinary office worker and a sweet and cruel wife dreaming of a perfect family.

dramas.name: My Man Is Cupid
dramas.summary: Fairy Cheon Sang Hyuk is the long-standing owner of Sarangbang, a high-end Korean chain restaurant in Jongno, Seoul. He went missing after working as a detective at Jongno Police Station. He is a man who has built an impregnable wall between him and women and a fairy who has burned his wings for 500 years.

dramas.name: All the Liquors
dramas.summary: Han Ji Yu works in the marketing team of an alcohol-producing company named Pai Syn Tang Liquors. He is exuberant and loves drinking and eating, and his busy social life reflects this. One day, his team is charged with finding an up-and-coming chef to partner with – to help promote the company. The team settles on Park Ki Hoon, the handsome and talented chef at a wildly popular restaurant.However, there's a big catch: Park Ki Hoon hates alcohol! He refuses to sell alcoholic beverages in his restaurant – and even kicks out customers who try to smuggle liquor into the eatery! When Han Ji Yu arrives at Park Ki Hoon's restaurant to explain the company's plan, the latter refuses. But Han Ji Yu refuses to be put off – and takes a part-time job at the restaurant in a bid to change Park Ki Hoon's mind. As the men start to get to know each other, Park Ki Hoon begins to mellow. And as time passes, they begin to develop feelings for one another. Could love be on the menu?

dramas.name: Our Dating Sim
dramas.summary: Lee Wan and Shin Ki Tae are best friends. At school, they are almost inseparable and are always to be found hanging out together outside the classroom. Lee Wan is also attracted to Shin Ki Tae, and wants to start a romantic relationship with him. One day, Lee Wan confesses his feelings to his friend, who is stunned by this. The duo parts on unhappy terms.Now, seven years later, the two young men are trying to navigate the job market – with varying degrees of success. Shin Ki Tae has become a middle manager at a team leader at a startup gaming company. He has built up a reputation as a programming ace. Lee Wan, meanwhile, has become a keen illustrator. When Shin Ki Tae's company posts a job ad for an illustrator for a new dating-themed game, Lee Wan comes to the interview. Could romance spark for these two the second time around?

dramas.name: The Frog
dramas.summary: One tranquil summer, a mysterious woman checks into a vacation rental — triggering events that disrupt the lives of the owner and those around him.

dramas.name: Unintentional Love Story
dramas.summary: It started with an ulterior motive, but falling in love is not part of the plan! The heartwarming romance between two men who fall in love and regain trust in a relationship that started with a lie. In the second year of employment, Ji Won-Young, an employee of the general affairs department of the Tae Pyeong Group, is implicated in the shady dealings of his immediate superior and is dismissed from his position. In order to escape from the complicated reality, Won-Young goes on a trip to Gangneung. After breaking a tableware that was treasured by the owner of the hotel where he was staying, he went to a tableware store to buy a replacement. He even changed his name to Cha Joo Hyun. Tae-Joon who lives as the owner of a small tableware store called Moon Pot in Gangneung Youth Mall, suddenly disappeared two years ago. When Won-Young learns that the chairman of the Pacific Group wants to sign an exclusive contract with Tae-Joon, he starts to approach Tae Joon in order to get his job back. But the more time they spend together, the more Won-Young is attracted to Tae-Joon, and Tae-Joon also grows fond of the cheerful and gentle Yuan-Ying...

dramas.name: Stealer: The Treasure Keeper
dramas.summary: A comic action drama in which a veiled cultural asset thief 'Skunk' and an unofficial cultural asset recovery team 'Karma' unite against those who cannot be judged by the law.

dramas.name: My Gold, My Jade
dramas.summary: A work about the delightful and heartbreaking story of a family growing up while raising a child, centering on a single dad Geum Kang-san and adopted child Ok Mi-rae who is the apple of his eye.

dramas.name: Queen of Masks
dramas.summary: A story that takes place in front of three successful friends when an old friend who became a murderer due to their lies 10 years ago, appears. The four face a whirlwind of life because of a man, and start a war of jealousy and desire.

dramas.name: DMZ Daeseong-dong
dramas.summary: An action-comic human drama about what happens in South Korea when North Korean soldiers who win the first prize lottery of 52 billion won defect from North Korea.

dramas.name: The Eighth Sense
dramas.summary: Ji Hyun is a freshman at a university in Seoul. He comes from a small rural town and is used to living in the quiet countryside. He struggles to form meaningful relationships, and moving to the busy South Korean capital has left him feeling disorientated and confused. The older Jae Won, meanwhile, is now returning to Seoul – and the same university – after completing his mandatory military service.The duo starts to develop a mutual curiosity about one another. But things begin to escalate when Ji Hyun joins the same surfing club that Jae Won attends. Their bond begins to deepen as Ji Hyun discovers a love of surfing and the sea. When the surfing club embarks on a journey, the duo finds themselves together alone – and share a kiss. Later, though, Jae Won begins to act as if nothing happened between them. Is this just a fleeting attraction...or the love of a lifetime?

dramas.name: The Fate of Heaven
dramas.summary: A tragic story of a father and daughter begins when his greed turns them into sworn enemies.

dramas.name: Queen of Tears
dramas.summary: Baek Hyun Woo, who is the pride of the village of Yongduri, is the legal director of the conglomerate Queens Group, while chaebol heiress Hong Hae In is the "queen" of Queens Group's department stores. Queen of Tears will tell the miraculous, thrilling, and humorous love story of this married couple, who manage to survive a crisis and stay together against all odds.

dramas.name: My Lovely Liar
dramas.summary: Mok Sol Hee is a young woman who has become quite cynical over the years because of her ability to detect lies. However, she's thrust into a mystery upon learning that a murder suspect is telling the truth regarding his innocence. Until this point, the lead character thinks of her ability as a curse rather than a gift, and the story in general tells of her transformation into a liar hunter.

dramas.name: Numbers: Watchdogs in the Building Forest
dramas.summary: Ho Woo is the first high school graduate to immediately become an accountant at the nation 2019s top accounting firm. He has outstanding memory, observation, adaptation, and justice that distinguish him from other accountants. Yun Ah is his senior colleague who mentors him in his work and helps him reveal the secrets behind the numbers. Jae Kyun is the vice president of the firm who has a reputation for being generous, but he will not hesitate to get what he wants. Can Ho Woo uphold justice in this corrupt firm?

dramas.name: Pure Boxer
dramas.summary: A drama about a genius boxer Lee Kwon Sook who meets sports agent Kim Tae Young ahead of the Grand Slam, and faces an inflection point in her life.

dramas.name: Everything We Loved
dramas.summary: A high-teen romance that tells the story of youth who cannot give up both love and friendship. Two best friends, Go Yoo and Go Joon Hee, fall into a love triangle with the appearance of transfer student Han So Yun, who falls in love at the same time. On top of that, after Go Joon Hee receives a kidney transplant from Go Yoo, the mysterious story that occurs when the characteristics of the organ donor are transferred to the beneficiary is added.

dramas.name: Race
dramas.summary: With little on her resume but full of passion, Park Yoonjo manages to get hired by a top company through an unbiased recruitment project. Proving her value at work is hard, but she powers through life with her old friend and colleague Ryu Jaemin, role model Goo Yijung, and best supporter Seo Donghoon.

dramas.name: Live Your Own Life
dramas.summary: Hyo Shim's Self-Reliance depicts the story of Hyo Shim, who has sacrificed her life for her family, starts to value herself and tries to lead an independent life. I want to consider what a relationship is, whether Simcheong's 'filial piety', which threw herself into Indangsu for Bongsa Shim, is still valid, and how to love the only family in the world more wisely and wisely.

dramas.name: Happy Merry Ending
dramas.summary: Seung Jun has been a wedding singer for many years and has become bored with this job. He no longer has any illusions about the romance people yearn for through these ceremonies. One day, he meets Jae Hyun, who is also working at the wedding as a host, and the lively and charming guy in front of him is his ideal type! As the two of them get closer and closer each wedding, the introductory notes of love are starting to play out between them…

dramas.name: Love Mate
dramas.summary: An office push-and-pull romance between a tough iron-clad man who doesn't believe in love and a straight-forward man who is sincere in love. It depicts the story of team leader Seo I-joon and new employee Jeong Ha-ram, who are entangled in their first meeting, falling for each other and learning about true love.

dramas.name: Delightfully Deceitful
dramas.summary: A cooperative drama between a fraudster who cannot empathize and an overly sympathetic lawyer, as well as a revenge play against absolute evil.

dramas.name: Your Lady, Durian
dramas.summary: A melodramatic fantasy in which two women from Joseon Dynasty, belonging from a noble family, become intertwined with men through time travel to the year 2023, the present.

dramas.name: My 20th Twenty
dramas.summary: A romance fantasy drama about an episode in which a cursed person who has to live at the age of 20 for the rest of his life infiltrates a resort with clues to change his fate.

dramas.name: Hello? Spring is Coming
dramas.summary: Every coming out is difficult, but most of all, coming out in front of the family is the hardest. Can I make a coming out to my family for a loved one?

dramas.name: Bon Appetit
dramas.summary: Yoonsoo is a dedicated office worker who immerses himself in his job, shuttling between home and the office day in and day out. His life seems monotonous, filled with loneliness and sadness. However, one day, his life is completely turned upside down by his neighbor, Doohoon. Doohoon is Yoonsoo's junior from college, a young man who suddenly dropped out of school. One day, Doohoon appears in front of Yoonsoo, holding a bowl of sweet rice soup as a housewarming gift. Yoonsoo accepts this dessert, and suddenly, his world brightens as the sweetness warms his weary soul. Doohoon confesses that he once lacked the courage to confess his feelings to Yoonsoo and chose to avoid him. However, over the years, Doohoon has put this past behind him, while Yoonsoo begins to unconsciously care about Doohoon from that moment on. From that day forward, Yoonsoo and Doohoon's lives undergo a transformation. After work, they spontaneously become a perfect pair for sharing meals, and every meal becomes precious quality time for them. Yoonsoo even realizes that his feelings for Doohoon are growing warmer and deeper with each passing day.

dramas.name: Follow the Wind
dramas.summary: Baram, the frontman of the band Ddara Baram, learned from the painful failure of his first love that he should be cautious with his feelings and is now a decisive person. During his high school days, he met Hantae at a guitar training class, and due to a certain event, she developed feelings for him, becoming both his good friend and manager. In truth, Baram's feelings for Hantae have already surpassed friendship, but he has not shown it. One day, when Baram becomes embroiled in a plagiarism controversy and his attitude becomes extremely negative, Hantae decides to help him in his own way.

dramas.name: Happiness Battle
dramas.summary: A suspense drama depicting mothers engaged in a fierce social media battle to destroy each others' happiness for their own, to free themselves from oppression, hurt, and secrets, and regain their true selves.

dramas.name: Oh! Youngsim
dramas.summary: Oh Young Sim is single and in her 30's. She has worked as a TV variety show PD for 8 years.She wants to make people laugh with her TV shows, but they were always cancelled due to low popularity ratings. Her career is now in a crisis. She has a chance to produce a love entertainment show as a pilot program. For the show, Oh Young Sim casts famous start-up founder Mark Wang as a guest. She is surprised that Mark Wang is Wang Kyung Tae. When they were little, Wang Kyung Tae had a crush on Oh Young Sim and he always let her know how he felt about her. Oh Young Sim did not feel the same way towards Wang Kyung Tae at the time. He then suddenly moved to the United States with his family. They lost contact with each other afterwards. Now, 20 years after they were last together, Wang Kyung Tae appears in front of her as CEO Mark Wang. Meanwhile, PD Lee Chae Dong works with PD Oh Young Sim in the same variety show department. Also around Oh Young Sim is her friend Goo Wol Sook.

dramas.name: Finland Papa
dramas.summary: A healing drama about people in need of emotional support who gather around a cafe named "Finland Papa". It is managed by a faceless owner who falls in love with a woman in her twenties who works at the cafe, mending her own inner wounds.

dramas.name: Starstruck
dramas.summary: The only place where two poor teenagers can relax is the amusement park under the starry night sky. Hanjun originally thought he was the only one looking up at the stars there, unaware that there were others in the same space. Hanjun greeted him, and the other child responded with a "hello." Under the star-filled night sky, the two lonely and impoverished teenagers, Hanjun and Yujae, met like this. After Hanjun and Yujae first met in junior high school, they both entered the same high school and were striving to get into the same university. With the charming Yoon Chaeyoung, the cautious Park Junghwan, and Lee Ingyu, who was fully devoted to studying. They spent intense daily lives together as high school seniors. But Hanjun always felt that he had the most fun and happiness when he was with Yujae. Therefore, one day Hanjun realized that the feelings in his heart were more than just friendship, but something else... One day, Yoon Chaeyoung, who had been secretly in love with Yujae, decided to confess. Hanjun became confused upon hearing this news. Realizing his true feelings, Hanjun decided to sort out his own emotions... For one teenager, it was a unique friendship, but for the other teenager, it was a unique love. Like shining stars, their youth story unfolds from here...

dramas.name: Bitch X Rich
dramas.summary: After witnessing a murder at a prestigious high school, a girl from a low-income family is given the chance to attend the school to keep her quiet.

dramas.name: Lies Hidden in My Garden
dramas.summary: The story depicts the life of a woman who starts to doubt her happy daily life and two women struggling to escape from their unhappy daily lives.

dramas.name: Love Tractor
dramas.summary: Love Tractor tells the heartwarming rural love story that unfolds when Seonyul, a temporarily relocated city man, meets Yechan, a rural man who adores the countryside. Seonyul, a city man who comes to the countryside to experience life, knows nothing about farming. At that moment, Yechan, a passionate young man who loves rural life, appears before him. As Seonyul learns to adapt to rural living and engage in farming activities, he becomes increasingly attracted to Yechan's sincerity and enthusiasm. Together, these two young individuals embark on a chaotic and romantic countryside journey of healing and love.

dramas.name: The Villain of Romance
dramas.summary: A coming-of-age story and realistic romance about young college "villains" who are still learning about love.

dramas.name: Miraculous Brothers
dramas.summary: An exciting mystery unfolds between Dong Joo, a hot-blooded young man who has only debts, and Kang San, an unidentified boy with mysterious abilities.

dramas.name: Romance by Romance
dramas.summary: Having never been involved in a long-term relationship, Ha Yoon was hoping that her current boyfriend, Nam Tae Ryun, would be the one to change all of that. But when he announces he wants to break up with her before they even reach their 100th day, Ha Yoon refuses to accept her fate without a fight.

dramas.name: Jun and Jun
dramas.summary: Life in a modern South Korean office can be eventful! Lee Jun once hoped to become a top-billing pop star, but has turned his back on his dreams. Now this former idol star needs to enter the world of work. But without any experience, he is forced to take on a role as an intern at a cosmetics firm. Here he is reunited with someone from his past – a highly talented (but also highly flirtatious!) man named Choi Jun.Choi Jun has risen to the post of manager at the company, which means he is able to delegate work to the company's long-suffering interns! The interns' only ally is Lee Joo Ha, an assistant manager who tries to shield them from managers' ire! While the workload starts piling up for Lee Jun, so does the romantic tension between this former pop star and Choi Jun. And theirs is not the only possible office romance in the cards – as employees Simeon and Song Hyun Jae also start to feel the pull of love!

dramas.name: Not Others
dramas.summary: The story of a reckless mother and a cool daughter living together without countermeasures.

dramas.name: Destined with You
dramas.summary: The irresistible romance between a civil servant who obtains a forbidden book that was thoroughly sealed 300 years ago and a popular lawyer who becomes a victim of the forbidden book.

dramas.name: Cold Blooded Intern
dramas.summary: Go Hae Ra worked hard as a merchandiser, but after having a child, she quit her job. For the past 7 years, she put all of her energy into raising her child. She now wants to resume her working career, but she struggles to find a job. One day, she takes an interview for an entry level position at Market House. There, she meets Choi Ji Won, the director of the product planning team who holds the real power at Market House thanks to her charisma and leadership abilities. Go Hae Ra and Choi Ji Won once worked together at another company, so Choi Ji Won decides to hire Go Hae Ra for an intern position in the product planning team. She offers a sweet, but cruel suggestion to Go Hae Ra.

dramas.name: Do Dream
dramas.summary: Jung Si Yeon is just your average high school student. Sweet and spunky, she spends her carefree days hanging out with her best friend, Yoon Hee, and crushing on the new transfer student, Sung Hyun. When she finds out Sung Hyun was a drummer in a band, she tells him she's in a band as well, in a desperate attempt to impress him.

dramas.name: My Dearest
dramas.summary: A love-story between a noble woman and a mysterious man who shows up in her hometown set in the 1600s during the Qing invasion. Yu Gil Chae is a pretty, bubbly and a bit spoiled young lady who's named as the 99 tailed fox of Neunggun-ri. She is a bit of an outcast too because other young ladies are jealous of her. They seem to think she's too straight forward and her behavior is inappropriate for a young lady while young noble men think highly of her. Gil Chae knows how to get men to fall for her but fails to capture the heart of the person she likes. Lee Jang Hyun is a mysterious man who suddenly appears in the Neunggun-ri social scene one day. Nobody really knows about him. Young nobles don't like him while he has elderly people wrapped around his finger. He's been dating around a lot but becomes curious about a certain 99 tailed fox. And one day, the said fox crash lands to his arm literally. With the brewing war, the pair find themselves separated even before they start to make sense of their feelings.

dramas.name: Han River Police
dramas.summary: An action-comedy drama that follows the Han River Police Team as they become embroiled in crimes surrounding the river they guard day and night.

dramas.name: Death's Game
dramas.summary: Death's Game will tell the story of a man who gets more than one second chance at life after facing death.

dramas.name: The Elegant Empire
dramas.summary: A love story between a woman and a man who take revenge to recover neglected justice and lost families.

dramas.name: Why R U?
dramas.summary: Lee Won and Ji Oh are two beings from a different world. Ever since the university admission, their persistent enemy-like relationship has continued. Less did they know that those two would end up in a BL novel. Embarrassed by the unexpected remark of his younger sister and BL writer, Lee Jin, Lee Won makes an unusual oath. Either it's the curse of the BL novel, but he and Ji Oh have become partners in an acting class. Ji Oh is strangely obsessed with bullying Lee Won. As he keeps getting involved with the person he wants to avoid, Lee Won believes that the BL novel is turning into reality. Sun Woo resents the news of Do Yeon and Yu Gyeom dating. Sun Woo drunk called him when Yu Gym didn't show up at Do Yeon's birthday party. Somehow, he wakes up the next day and finds Yu Gyeom in the same bed.

dramas.name: The Kidnapping Day
dramas.summary: A special collaboration between the clumsy kidnapper Kim Myung Joon and an 11-year-old genius girl Roh Hee. Myung Joon is a first-time kidnapper who kidnaps a girl to pay for his daughter's hospital bills. He is suddenly chased as a murder suspect due to an unexpected incident. For some reason, the truth tracking of the kidnapper, who is lacking 2% but is human and weak-hearted, and the girl who is smart, is expected to be fun and touching.

dramas.name: Goryeo-Khitan War
dramas.summary: A story of King Hyeonjong of Goryeo and Commander-in-Chief Gang Gam Chan. They unite the people of Goryeo to one and lead a war against Khitan.

dramas.name: A Good Day to Be a Dog
dramas.summary: Hana has made every effort to avoid her inevitable family curse of turning into a dog after her first kiss. The only way for her to break the curse is to get a second kiss. How will that work when Hana's first kiss is with a guy deathly afraid of dogs?!

dramas.name: Bumpy Family
dramas.summary: A romantic family comedy about a divorced couple who broke up 30 years ago out of hate, reuniting as in-laws through their children and overcoming long overdue conflicts and enmity.

dramas.name: The Third Marriage
dramas.summary: The drama tells the story of a woman who sacrificed her life for her younger sister, but after losing her sister in a shocking accident, she enters a chaebol family with a desire for blood-red revenge.

dramas.name: Boss-dol Mart
dramas.summary: The story of an idol group who had to disband because of an unexpected incident and is now taking on the challenge of running a mart. As idol group "Thunder Boys" operates a failing mart, they face many challenges, each more ridiculous than the next.

dramas.name: The Deal
dramas.summary: Deal tells the story of three former high school classmates in their twenties who get together for drinks for the first time in a long while. However, things take an unexpected turn when two of them impulsively decide to kidnap the other, and the ensuing complications lead all three of them down a dark and turbulent path

dramas.name: Twinkling Watermelon
dramas.summary: Twinkling Watermelon follows a story about CODA, (a deaf child born under deaf parents) a boy born of natural talent for music, and Eun Gyul, crash-landing into an unfamiliar space through a suspicious musical instrument store. Eun Gyul forms the band Watermelon Sugar with the youth he met there and communicates with them through music.

dramas.name: Aema
dramas.summary: In 1980s Korea, a movie star and a starlet defy male-dominated industry rules and backstage corruption while filming the provocative ''Madame Aema''.

dramas.name: Evilive
dramas.summary: Han Dong-soo, a livelihood lawyer who gets a case by recklessly asking for a visit from an inmate who is not familiar with the situation. He receives a dubious offer from gangster Seo Do-young, who was once a promising baseball prospect, to follow a woman. A single derailment that he thought was the first and last. Because of that choice, Dong-soo is cornered and caught in a trap set by a gangster, Do-young, and becomes the designer of an internet gambling site. Dong-soo, a lawyer who was despised and treated coldly as the lowest class in the legal profession, discovers his unexpected talent in the world of crime and begins to awaken to his hidden desires. And colluding with Do-young, they continue their dangerous and strange friendship.

dramas.name: Serendipity's Embrace
dramas.summary: Ten years have passed, and he thought he'd forgotten about his first love. One day, he comes across his first love. Kang Hu-young is tall, handsome, and intelligent, and has lived a carefree life. When he came back to Korea from the US after ten years, he coincidentally ran into his first love. It brought back the memory from the past, making his heart race again... But unlike Hu-young, Lee Hong-ju is living an ordinary life. She believes a romantic relationship is a luxury and love is a waste of energy. She tries to stay away from him, but somehow, her heart starts to flutter as well. Is it just a serendipitous encounter? Or is it fate?

dramas.name: Queen of Divorce
dramas.summary: Once the daughter-in-law of the biggest law firm in South Korea, Kim Sa Ra lost everything when she was betrayed by her husband. In order to avoid others falling into the same misery, she became a divorce troubleshooter. Together with her business partner Dong Ki Joon she punishes bad spouses and provides help for those that finds themselves in similar situations as to her.

dramas.name: Dear Hongrang
dramas.summary: When a long-missing heir returns with lost memories, love and suspicion entwine. Is he truly Hongrang, or a stranger disturbing hearts and family ties?

dramas.name: Castaway Diva
dramas.summary: Castaway Diva is a romantic comedy following the story of a girl who drifted out onto a deserted island while on her way to Seoul to partake in an audition to become a singer.

dramas.name: LTNS
dramas.summary: Woo-Jin is married to Samuel. They've been married for 5 years and do not have a child. Woo-Jin is goal-oriented and aggressive when it comes to achieving her goal. She is also tenderhearted at other times. She works as a receptionist at a 3 star hotel that pays a modest wage. One day, Woo-Jin happens to learn a secret about a couple who she is friends with. Meanwhile, Samuel has a mild mannered appearance, but he has rage burning deep in his mind. He graduated from a prestigious university and worked for a big company. He suffered mentally working there and quit his job. He now works as a taxi driver. Samuel teams up with Woo-Jin and they secretly follow a couple involved in an affair. They then blackmail them to make money. Doing that, Woo-Jin and Samuel face their own relationship as a couple.

dramas.name: Perfect Marriage Revenge
dramas.summary: Adapted from the webtoon "The Essence of a Perfect Marriage" written by Young and Lee Beom Bae and illustrated by Je Ri Bol, "Perfect Marriage Revenge" is a 2023 South Korean drama directed by Oh Sang Won.

dramas.name: Moon in the Day
dramas.summary: A dangerous and affectionate romance between a man whose time stops after being killed by his beloved lover and a woman who loses her memory of her previous life and whose time passes away endlessly.

dramas.name: A Bloody Lucky Day
dramas.summary: A Bloody Lucky Day is a thriller series about an ordinary taxi driver Oh Taek carrying a guest to Mokpo, who offers a high price, and then realizing that he is a serial killer and starts a horror drive.

dramas.name: The Story of Park's Marriage Contract
dramas.summary: A time-slip romance drama about the contractual marriage between bachelor Kang Tae Ha and Park Yun Woo, who has traveled to modern day from 19th century Joseon.

dramas.name: My Demon
dramas.summary: A fantasy rom-com about the demon-like chaebol heiress Do Do Hee and the demon Jung Goo Won, who loses his powers one day, as they enter a contractual marriage.

dramas.name: Bump Up Business
dramas.summary: Bump Up Business is about a Kpop idol named Eden who's about to debut, he encounters an idol under the same agency as him named Ji Hoon. Not long after seeing Ji Hoon, Eden is told that he can only make his debut by doing a Business Gay Performance with Ji Hoon. Eden wants to reject such a reality but he follows what his agency wants him to do. Eden and Ji Hoon still squabble but over time they start to get closer. Misunderstandings between Ji Hoon and Eden begin to build up, will they be able to clear up the misunderstandings and find their true feelings for each other?

dramas.name: High Cookie
dramas.summary: A drama about what happens when a dangerous handmade cookie that fulfills a dream devours an elite high school.

dramas.name: Tell Me That You Love Me
dramas.summary: A healing melodrama about the fate of Cha Jin Woo, a deaf person who is used to express emotions through pictures instead of words, and Jung Moo Eun, who expresses her heart with her voice.

dramas.name: Love Song for Illusion
dramas.summary: Love Song for Illusion is about a King who has two opposite personalities and an assassin who approaches him to avenge the death of her family but ends up falling in love with him after she is taken in as the King's concubine.

dramas.name: Boyhood
dramas.summary: Set in the backdrop of the mid-to-late 1980s, the drama tells the story of students at an agricultural high school in Chungcheong Province. Jang Byung Tae is a small and weak boy living in Onyang in South Chungcheong Province. He is at the bottom of the school's social ladder so he transfers to the neighboring Buyeo Agricultural High School. There, he faces an unexpected incident that becomes a turning point in his life.

dramas.name: Maestra: Strings of Truth
dramas.summary: Cha Se Eum used to be a violinist, but she is now a conductor of an orchestra. She has pursued her career boldly and with passion. She is now in a position where others are envious. What others don't know is that Cha Se Eum carries a secret. That secret will shake her life. Meanwhile, mysterious cases take place within her orchestra. Cha Se Eum looks into the cases and approaches the truth surrounding her.

dramas.name: Welcome to Samdal-ri
dramas.summary: After losing his mother—who worked as a haenyeo —at a young age due to a mistaken weather report, Jo Yong Pil makes up his mind to become a weather forecaster and protect the elders of his hometown. However, his passion and refusal to let misinformation slide earns him a reputation at work as a stubborn troublemaker who isn't afraid to argue with his boss.

dramas.name: A Breeze of Love
dramas.summary: Dong-Uk who is always sensitive from being haunted by ghosts every night. However, he manages to sleep peacefully for the first time in his life, when he sleeps next to Dohyeon. They thought they were meant for one another and knew everything about each other, even though they didn't talk much. Dong-Uk feels that their relationship is not working well and tries to hold on to Dohyeon, while Dohyeon is afraid to find out what's about to come when the happy moments are gone. Just like the weather forecast, their love is so unpredictable.

dramas.name: Night Has Come
dramas.summary: A mystery teen drama that takes place when a class of second-year high school students is suddenly forced to play mafia games in real life during their retreat.

dramas.name: Secret Playlist
dramas.summary: Han Joo is your ordinary university student… except for the fact that she's also the up-and-coming Metube cover artist, PLII. When popular boy group member Levi takes notice of PLII and requests to collaborate, Han Joo will do anything to hide her secret identity. But as the two grow closer working on a class project, Han Joo's cover begins to unravel. Will Levi discover her secret?

dramas.name: Karma
dramas.summary: A fateful accident intertwines six lives in a thrilling tale of karma and crime, where each must face their own dark truths and connections. A hit-and-run. A cover-up. A debt-fueled murder plot. Karma weaves together the fates of six characters, each bound by a single, irreversible moment. The Witness observed a mysterious accident in the dead of night, setting the Unspoken Fate in motion. The Surgeon, haunted by a lifelong trauma, and confronted by the painful past she vowed never to face again. The Debtor & the Outsider, jobless and trapped, plunge headlong into the fate of dark deals. The Doctor & the Alluring Girlfriend, as one fateful mistake on a dark night spirals uncontrollably into a catastrophic accident. Six lives, one inescapable fate.

dramas.name: My Happy Ending
dramas.summary: Seo Jae Won, a woman who is obsessed with and chases after success as she had an unfortunate childhood, trying to escape from her unhealthy desires and obsessions.

dramas.name: Chart Running Scholar
dramas.summary: 'Scholar Running the Chart' is a time stock romance about a Joseon scholar Yuanta who travels to the modern era and meets Geum Min-ji, a clerk from the MZ generation. , and discovers a talent for investing in stocks that he did not know.

dramas.name: Marry My Husband
dramas.summary: Kang Ji-won, a terminally ill cancer patient, is killed by her husband and best friend after she witnesses them having an affair. She wakes up 10 years before the incident and decides to seek revenge with the help of Yu Ji-hyuk, a director at the company where she works. Now, she must reclaim her fate and eliminate the trash from her life.

dramas.name: Like Flowers in Sand
dramas.summary: Kim Bae Doo is the youngest born of a prestigious ssireum family and competes on the ssireum team for the Geosan County Office. Despite his extraordinary talent, Baek Doo is thinking of retiring from the sport altogether. However, when childhood friend Oh Yoo Kyung walks back into his life and becomes the leader of the ssireum team, he u-turns on his plans to retire.

dramas.name: Between Him and Her
dramas.summary: It is the story of a long-time couple whose relationship has cooled down and is threatened due to the seven-year itch. Han Sung Ok is a jewelry worker in the business run by her and her boyfriend, Jung Hyun Sung, who works as a fashion designer. One night, Han Sung Ok and Jung Hyun Sung come face to face with each other in front of a motel elevator. They are each accompanied by another person.

dramas.name: Flex x Cop
dramas.summary: A fun-loving rich boy gets entangled in an incident and joins a violent crime investigation team. By mobilizing his enormous wealth and personal connections, the third-generation chaebol detective catches criminals who are beyond the reach of the police.

dramas.name: Captivating the King
dramas.summary: A cruel love story between King Lee In, who is in danger of both royal and political power struggles, and Kang Hee Soo, who tries to seduce the King and get revenge, but gets seduced instead

dramas.name: Knight Flower
dramas.summary: Set in the Joseon era, Knight Flower is an action-comedy drama starring Lee Ha Nee as Jo Yeo Hwa, a woman who has lived a quiet and modest life as a virtuous widow by day for 15 years. However, she is secretly leading a double life: at night, she valiantly sneaks out to help and take care of those in need.

dramas.name: In Your Radiant Season
dramas.summary: Chan lives every day like it is summer vacation. Haran is trapped in a lonely winter. When their forgotten past reunites them, Chan is determined to gift her another spring. Through laughter and tears, they face winter together and reach their spring in this heartwarming romance.

dramas.name: A Shop for Killers
dramas.summary: Set in modern-day Korea, A Shop For Killers sees college student Jung Ji Ahn diving for cover in her childhood home after a series of highly skilled assassins get her in their sights. Desperately fighting to survive, Ji Ahn will begin to remember invaluable lessons her uncle taught her before his apparent suicide, drawing on them to help her stay alive. Confused and cornered, Ji Ahn will have to work fast to uncover her uncle's hidden past and figure out why so many people are desperate to gain access to the house and the extensive arsenal hidden inside.

dramas.name: Doctor Slump
dramas.summary: A rom-com about doctors who are in a slump as they try to resuscitate their lives. Their story captures the love and growth of two characters who live in a rooftop house after quitting their jobs as doctors.

dramas.name: Mercy for None
dramas.summary: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death -- embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

dramas.name: Branding in Seongsu
dramas.summary: A relentless marketing executive and a warm-hearted intern are always at odds with each other but everything takes a wild turn when their souls switch after an unexpected kiss.

dramas.name: Wedding Impossible
dramas.summary: As a struggling actress, Na Ah Jung is the first to admit that her career isn't exactly soaring. Able to land various jobs as an extra, Ah Jung struggles to get the attention and traction she needs to bring her talent into the spotlight. However, her various roles portraying a married woman come in handy when her lifelong friend, Lee Do Han approaches her with an unexpected request.

dramas.name: The Trauma Code: Heroes on Call
dramas.summary: To create a top-tier trauma center, a war-seasoned doctor arrives bringing his blunt but skilled ways to transform his team into life-saving mavericks.

dramas.name: Without Blood or Tears
dramas.summary: A tragic story of sisters Lee Hye Won and Bae Do Eun who were separated at a young age due to their parents' divorce. When they reunite 20 years later after living very different lives, Bae Do Eun begins to burn with ambition.

dramas.name: A Killer Paradox
dramas.summary: When one accidental killing leads to another, an average college student finds himself stuck in an endless cat-and-mouse chase with a shrewd detective.

dramas.name: Love for Love's Sake
dramas.summary: At the age of 29, Tae Myung Ha suddenly enters into a game adapted from a novel, and now 19 years old, he meets his favorite fictional character, Cha Yeo Woon. In the darkest moment of his life, he needs to make Cha Yeo Woon happy, or face dire consequences.

dramas.name: Happy Ending
dramas.summary: Hyeon, a high school student, writes down his feelings for his friend Dongho in his diary. Then, Dong-ho sees the diary, and the two talk to confirm their feelings for each other. Can the ending for these two be a happy one?

dramas.name: Love Next Door
dramas.summary: A romantic comedy that tells the story of a woman trying to reboot her life after making mistakes, and her mother's friend's son, who is her living dark side.

dramas.name: Wonderful World
dramas.summary: Eun Soo Hyun is a psychology professor and a famous writer, but her life has completely changed. Her young son dies unjustly. Making things worse, the person responsible for her son's death isn't punished by the law. Eun Soo Hyun loses hope in this world. She decides to punish the person responsible for her son's death by herself. Her life is still in pain and despair. Somehow, Eun Soo Hyun gets involved with other people who suffer from pain similar to hers and solves their mysterious cases. They slowly get healed in the process.

dramas.name: The Impossible Heir
dramas.summary: When the illegitimate son of a conglomerate owner partners with his ambitious childhood friend, the duo will stop at nothing to seize their place at the top of the societal food chain.

dramas.name: When Life Gives You Tangerines
dramas.summary: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs --- proving love endures across time.

dramas.name: Pyramid Game
dramas.summary: Every Thursday afternoon, once a month, students at Sarang High School cast their votes in a popularity poll. The result? A brutal ranking system that determines the entire social hierarchy of the school. After starting at the bottom, can new transfer student Su Ji make her way to the top of the pyramid? Or will she topple the game altogether?

dramas.name: Midnight Photo Studio
dramas.summary: Seo Ki Joo is a photographer and runs a small photo studio. He is the 7th owner of the photo studio and the shop is only for ghosts. Ki Joo takes portraits of the ghosts that come into the store. Han Bom is a lawyer who is passionate about her work and does not tolerate injustice. Somehow, she ends up in a partnership with Ki Joo's photo studio. The studio also has two employees: Assistant Manager Go and Baek Nam Gu. Assistant Manager Go is in charge of bringing in ghosts as customers, and Nam Gu is in charge of taking care of small chores around the store.

dramas.name: Nothing Uncovered
dramas.summary: Seo Jung Won is an investigative reporter and the host of the current affairs television program "Grabbed by the Collar." Thanks to her unique and straightforward way of exposing all kinds of torts committed by culprits—all whilst making sarcastic remarks—she gains great popularity and attracts the general public's attention. When Jung Won is accused of murder, she joins with detective Kim Tae Hyun, and sets out to find the truth. Also helping her are her husband Seol Woo Jae and Woo Jae, respectively.

dramas.name: Missing Crown Prince
dramas.summary: Set in the Joseon era about a crown prince who is kidnapped by the woman who is set to become his wife. While on the run for their lives, romance winds up blossoming between them.

dramas.name: High School Return of a Gangster
dramas.summary: A middle-aged gangster finds himself body-swapped into the body of a bullied teen. Now inhabited by a tough-as-nails gangster, the teen starts to fight back against the power structure at his school and change his miserable existence.

dramas.name: Hide
dramas.summary: Hide follows the story of a woman, Na Moon Young, whose husband, Cha Sung Jae vanishes into thin air. As she traces the truth behind her husband's disappearance, she stumbles upon unbearable secrets.

dramas.name: Crash
dramas.summary: After Seoul's streets reach an unacceptable level of danger, the Traffic Crime Investigation team is formed to tackle the rising tide of insurance fraud, retaliatory driving, and road mishaps. Leading the charge is the brilliant but socially awkward Cha Yeon Ho, an elite university graduate who specializes in simulating accident scenes, despite his own inability to drive. He's joined by the tenacious ace investigator Min So Hee, whose sharp judgment and martial arts prowess keep the team in line. Together with the insightful leader Jung Chae Man, automotive expert Woo Dong Gi, and martial arts prodigy Eo Hyun Kyung, they race to uncover the truth behind every high-stakes collision to ensure that the streets remain as safe as they can be.

dramas.name: Chief Detective 1958
dramas.summary: Park Young Han is a young detective from Hwangcheon. He becomes furious at the reality of human dignity being violated and he struggles to deal with it. He teams up with his colleague detectives at the Jongnam Police Station in Seoul.

dramas.name: Hierarchy
dramas.summary: The top 0.01% of students control law and order at Jooshin High School, but a secretive transfer student chips a crack in their indomitable world.

dramas.name: Blood Free
dramas.summary: A drama that depicts a new era of artificially cultured meat, at a time when bleeding meat disappears from the human table, and begins with people questioning BF's behavior inside and outside, while BF, a biotechnology company that ends millions of years of 'domination' and 'subject peoples' relationships, dominates the cultured meat market.

dramas.name: Unmasked
dramas.summary: A comedy drama that tells the story of an investigative reporting crew, centered on the team leader Trigger, who is full of a sense of justice, and the PD, a fierce individualist, who uncover the truth behind mysterious events and save a program that is on the verge of being abolished.In modern-day Seoul, a crack team of investigative journalists fight for their careers after broadcasting a controversial story. With time running out, the team are given an impossible task if they want to save their jobs – solve a twenty-year-old cold case involving a famous actor who disappeared without a trace.

dramas.name: Light Shop
dramas.summary: The living and the dead intersecting as this world and the afterlife are connected through a store selling lighting.A series about six lost strangers who find themselves drawn to a mysterious shop that inexplicably holds the key to their past, present and future. With the help of their loved ones, will the strangers be able to escape the world between life and death, and return to their normal lives?

dramas.name: Uncle Samsik
dramas.summary: Set in 1960s South Korea, the series follows two men through their bromance and the obstacles they face during a turbulent time in the country's history.

dramas.name: Beauty and Mr. Romantic
dramas.summary: A love story about an actress who falls to the bottom overnight and a producer's effort to try and get her back on her feet because he loves her. A cheerful family drama that reveals the truth of the case and restores love and justice through revenge and a family's desire to go through confusion due to family conflicts.

dramas.name: Grand Shining Hotel
dramas.summary: A fantasy story about a man who accidentally gets drawn into a fictional world inside of a horror novel.

dramas.name: Lovely Runner
dramas.summary: Im Sol is devastated by the sudden and tragic death of her idol Ryu Sun-Jae, a former swimmer turned K-pop star. But in the midst of her grief, she magically travels back to 2008 - when Sun-Jae was only 19 years old! Sol is delighted that she can help him escape his sad future fate, and makes it her mission to change the future ... and maybe even find true love in the process. Will her attempts to change the course of the past succeed - or could they have unexpected consequences?

dramas.name: Brave Yong Soo Jung
dramas.summary: A romantic revenge drama with Yong Soo Jung, an outspoken winner who dreams of Im Sang Ok, the modern version of Colossus, and Yeo Eui Joo, a frugaller who entrusts her with his fate.

dramas.name: The Destiny Changer
dramas.summary: A fantasy fortune-telling mystery that predicts and changes the fate of its client through oriental fortune-telling fame and fortune.

dramas.name: Suji & Uri
dramas.summary: A heart-warming and healing romance story about Jin Soo Ji, a former celebrity doctor and Chae Woo Ri, a reckless rookie doctor.

dramas.name: Love is Like a Cat
dramas.summary: When global superstar Piuno is threatened by those who wish to see him brought low, there's only one thing he can do to save his reputation and his career: work at a pet daycare. Pushing aside his severed dislike for animals, Piuno begins working alongside the daycare's director, Daebyeol, who helps him find ways to overcome the trauma that first inspired his hatred of animals. As his heart begins to soften, unexpected feelings for Daebyeol begin to arise. Could their current working relationship grow into something more?

dramas.name: Blossom Campus
dramas.summary: Kim Minjae, a 21-year-old transfer student from Practical Music and a part-time worker, exudes a calm, meticulous, and thoughtful demeanor. His path continually intersects with Yoonchan's, whom he encountered by chance on his first day at the new school. Meanwhile, Lee Yoonchan, a 21-year-old Taekwondo major at Hankook University's College of Sports Culture and Arts, is introverted and somewhat clumsy, but his endearing silliness adds to his charm. A chance encounter between them leads to their paths intertwining, and over time, their bond deepens, blossoming into a romantic relationship.

dramas.name: Jazz for Two
dramas.summary: Taeyi hears a familiar melody fill the empty halls and makes his way to the old music room. He knows his brother is dead, but he can't help but hope, maybe, just maybe…it's his brother playing his favorite song. When he slams open the door, however, he finds Seheon, the new transfer student, at the piano. Disappointment comes crashing down and Taeyi can't control his anger. How dare Seheon play his brother's song? How dare he smile? How dare he say he loves jazz? "If I ever catch you playing the piano again…that'll be the end of you." And with that begins Taeyi and Seheon's story, as unpredictable and visceral as jazz.

dramas.name: Please Teach Me
dramas.summary: The drama follows a delightful and heartwarming BL romance that blossoms as Doyoon, a leading acting student, and Siwoo, a renowned idol celebrated for his acting prowess, find themselves in the same acting workshop class.

dramas.name: The Midnight Romance in Hagwon
dramas.summary: A secret and sweet real-life romance between veteran academy instructor Seo Hye Jin and her flirty student Lee Joon Ho, who returns after 10 years and stirs her heart.

dramas.name: Frankly Speaking
dramas.summary: A childish and rude life-changing comic melodrama in which announcer Song Ki-baek meets passionate entertainment writer On Woo-joo.

dramas.name: Gray Shelter
dramas.summary: Cha SooHyuk is focused only on his survival, without any grand goal. He reunites with Lee YoonDae, who he was very close with. YoonDae was living with his girlfriend but now has nowhere to go. They end up living together.

dramas.name: Boys Be Brave
dramas.summary: JinWoo, is a young man who finds himself living with his crush, KiSub, who entered his home uninvited and crashed on his couch for a little too long. The narrative also explores the relationship between Sunny and InHo, who hold onto a secret from their high school days.

dramas.name: Eccentric Romance
dramas.summary: Jay, an international student from Thailand, comes to Korea to see his friend Sung Hoon. The two enrolled in the same college "Health and Happiness" class, and need to submit a physical body assessment for their final project. While Sung Hoon already works out regularly, Jay isn't in the greatest shape, and he struggles in the gym. Enter Jin Wook, a personal trainer who takes a special interest in Jay, much to Sung Hoon's displeasure. However, there's something strange about Jin Wook – despite his kindness toward Jay, suspicions begin to rise that Jin Wook may be involved in a murder and missing person incident. Is there a happy ending in store for Jay and Sung Hoon, or will Jay's budding relationship with Jin Wook cost him an unspeakable price?

dramas.name: Connection
dramas.summary: The crumbling friendship of friends is revealed as they uncover the death of a high school friend who left behind a five billion won insurance money.

dramas.name: HeeSu in Class 2
dramas.summary: The drama is based on a popular webtoon of the same name. The story is about the youthful romance of HeeSu, an ordinary 18-year old boy, and his neighbor who has a secret.

dramas.name: Actor:eal
dramas.summary: Actor:eal depicts the story of two actors portraying as friends who have known for 10 years, with one harboring feelings towards the other. A new character introduces hinting a bigger picture between the two actor—it is still acting or being real?

dramas.name: The Atypical Family
dramas.summary: A story about Bok Gwi Joo who has extraordinary abilities saving Da Hae, his fated destiny.

dramas.name: The 8 Show
dramas.summary: Eight strangers with unique stories join a show taking place in an eight-story building where they must entertain an invisible crowd to win prize money.

dramas.name: Blue Boys
dramas.summary: The drama follows Jaemin, exhausted from job hunting, who finds himself experiencing new emotions after a chance encounter with Nami, an old high school friend. However, misunderstandings about Nami's job lead to conflict. This drama navigates the journey of discovering true love and understanding.

dramas.name: Lonely Girls
dramas.summary: Mina, who has many friends but is disappointed that no one matches her tastes, begins her first lesbian relationship after being confessed to by her friend Jieun, whom she matched with on a dating app and shares similar tastes with. After reconciliation, they share their true feelings.

dramas.name: Dare to Love Me
dramas.summary: A full-fledged defense romantic comedy about Shin Yoon Bok, a pupil from Seongsan village with Confucianism in his bones, and Kim Hong Do, an aggressive modern woman who only knows how to go straight.

dramas.name: Bitter Sweet Hell
dramas.summary: Bitter Sweet Hell tells the story of Korea's best psychological counselor Young Won and her mother-in-law Sa Gang facing each other's secrets and truths due to their husband and son.

dramas.name: DNA Lover
dramas.summary: So Jin, a genetic researcher who loves DNA, decides to end her relationship with a playboy boyfriend and sets out to find a genetically compatible partner for a happy relationship. Whom among the two men that So Jin meets, obstetrician-gynecologist Yeon Woo and firefighter Kang Hoon, will be the perfect match for her? A captivating story intertwined with genetics! This story portrays the struggles, love, and everyday lives of young friends.

dramas.name: Dreaming of a Freaking Fairytale
dramas.summary: In this 21st century hybrid fairy tale, a woman is determined to become a Cinderella, so she gets a job at an exclusive club and sets her sights on her future Prince Charming. He might be handsome and wealthy, but he's also an arrogant jerk with trust issues, and no interest in wom

dramas.name: My Sweet Mobster
dramas.summary: A romance filled with excitement between Ji Hwan, the eldest brother who clears his dark past, and Eun Ha, the mini-unnie who plays with the children.

dramas.name: To the X Who Hated Me
dramas.summary: E-Jae's mum has a boarder move into their house, Woori. Soon after, they become girlfriends and start a YouTube channel.

dramas.name: Gangnam B-Side
dramas.summary: A pariah detective is pulled back into the game after his daughter's friend goes missing. The latest in a long line of women to go missing in the Gangnam area of Seoul, the detective delves back into a world of vice, drugs and corruption to uncover something that threatens to topple some of the city's wealthiest elite.

dramas.name: Welcome to the Lesbian Bar
dramas.summary: The lives of seven queer women intersect at a local lesbian bar as they meet, part, and share their colourful stories over a variety of equally colourful drinks.

dramas.name: Miss Night and Day
dramas.summary: A woman who magically switches between her 20s and 50s lands an internship at the Prosecution Service, caught between two generations and a tough boss.

dramas.name: Black Out
dramas.summary: Jung Woo is a straight-A student, loved by his community, and has already been accepted into medical school by early admissions. However, the day after the national college entrance exam, he is arrested on the charge of murdering two of his female classmates.Ten years later, Jung Woo is now a 30-year-old young man. Having served out his sentence, he is released from prison and returns home. The town has completely changed, and he vows to leave to begin a new life, but odd things keep happening to him and around him, preventing him from leaving.

dramas.name: When the Phone Rings
dramas.summary: Korea's youngest presidential spokesperson finds his cold, calculated three-year marriage thrown into questions when his wife, a sign language interpreter, is mysteriously abducted.

dramas.name: Mayfly Angel
dramas.summary: Jaehee comforts her friend Haesu after a break up.

dramas.name: No Way Out: The Roulette
dramas.summary: A battle between 'the one who wants to live' and 'the one who wants to kill' amid an 'open murder appeal' with a reward of 20 billion won when the felon of the century is released from prison.

dramas.name: Undercover High School
dramas.summary: A comic drama about the activities of an NIS agent who hid his identity and infiltrated as a high school student to track down the whereabouts of the missing gold bullion of Emperor Gojong

dramas.name: heart.zip
dramas.summary: The mini-series is a zip file in which each episode is a special folder. The collections are "Unexpected Kisses", "Good Word Fights", "Exciting Moments", "What Happened While Recording TikTok", "Borrowed a Hidden Camera to Confess". The unusual format conveys some impressions and moments from the lives of ordinary people, helping to find reflections of themselves in the stories of the characters.

dramas.name: Secret Ingredient
dramas.summary: A Korean man who gives up his entire luxurious life in Seoul in search of his childhood girlfriend, someone he's never forgotten all these years, in the hopes that she would fall in love with him, not for who they were back then or who they are now, but for what they can aspire to be: happy, fulfilled and blissfully in love with one another.

dramas.name: The Whirlwind
dramas.summary: A whirlwind clash ensues when a deputy prime minister of economy stands against the prime minister who aims to uproot the corrupt powers that be.

dramas.name: Tarot
dramas.summary: A brutal fate mystery series that tells the story of being trapped in the curse of tarot cards twisted by a moment's choice.

dramas.name: Scandal
dramas.summary: A fierce, passionate battle begins between a woman who wants it all and a woman who risks it all for revenge.

dramas.name: Adult Kids
dramas.summary: A hyper-realistic drama depicting the daily lives of clumsy women in their 30s in the fashion industry and their joys and sorrows at work.

dramas.name: Fake Buddies
dramas.summary: Fake male and female friend finally meet.

dramas.name: Perfect Family
dramas.summary: A story of the family of Choi Sun Hee, who seems to be happy and perfect to anyone, going through the death of her friend Gyeong Ho one day.

dramas.name: Red Swan
dramas.summary: Oh Wan Soo, a former world-class golfer married into the powerful Hwain Group, finds herself targeted by death threats. She crosses paths with Seo Do Yoon, a bodyguard investigation a friend's death that is tied to the Hwain Group. Together, they unravel Hwain Group's secrets tainted with desire.

dramas.name: The Tyrant
dramas.summary: A secret project in Korea is exposed to the U.S. The U.S. demands the termination of the project, but a delivery accident occurs during the NIS's attempt to hand over the sample. Paul, a U.S. Agent, harshly pressures the NIS after the incident and confronts the leader of the project, Director Choe. Meanwhile, Jagyeong, a key character in this case, and Lim Sang, a retired veteran, begin chasing Director Choe's subordinate, Moyong, for different reasons. Everyone gathers in the end, and an unexpected turn of events takes place as ownership of the last sample is at stake.

dramas.name: The Auditors
dramas.summary: At JU Construction Company, notorious for countless corruption cases, the audit team is busy at work. The team comprises a polar opposite duo: a cold team leader and a generous Gen Z employee. Together, they navigate through turbulent teamwork at first. Yet, as they collectively tackle diverse cases, they harmonize into an unstoppable investigative pair.

dramas.name: The Pork Cutlets
dramas.summary: A tragic human comedy drama about the village head who took the lead in neutering Onghwa Village's Cassanova dog, Baek-goo, and ends up in the same situation as the dog when he suddenly undergo a vasectomy.

dramas.name: Good Partner
dramas.summary: Facing her own divorce, seasoned divorce lawyer Cha Eun Kyung has grown jaded with the concept of Justice, instead opting for the path with the most monetary gain. This changes after she begins working with passionate rookie lawyer Han Yoo Ri, who believes in helping people regardless of the money.

dramas.name: The Chairman of Class 9
dramas.summary: A delinquent 2nd-year student becomes the chairman of the board of a prestigious high school left behind by his father. Na Yi Soo may have grown up in an environment that others would envy, but he harbors hatred for his father and heads to Balhae High School, which his father cherished, in order to seek revenge. The process of change between Yi Soo, who has lived a rougher life than anyone else, and the nation's most elite students who have lived upright lives, as they get to know each other, and the love that blooms in the process, will be dynamically unfolded.

dramas.name: Romance in the House
dramas.summary: A drama depicting the story of imperfect humans meeting as a family and dreaming of perfect love.

dramas.name: Bad Memory Eraser
dramas.summary: A nourishing romantic drama about a man whose life is changed with the eraser of bad memories and a woman who holds his fate.

dramas.name: Your Honor
dramas.summary: The story of the forces that inherited wealth centered around the Woowon Group headquarters in the fictional Woowon City adjacent to the sea, the voodoo cartel that dominates the lawless area, and Judge Song Pan Ho, who comforts citizens seeking justice.

dramas.name: Resident Playbook
dramas.summary: Set at the Jongno branch of Yulje Medical Center, the series follows the hospital lives and turbulent friendships of young obstetrics and gynecology residents who proudly enter the unpopular department in an era of low birth rates.

dramas.name: No Gain No Love
dramas.summary: A comical romance between a woman who faked marriage because she didn't want to lose money and a man who became a fake groom because he didn't want to hurt a woman.

dramas.name: What Comes After Love
dramas.summary: Five years have passed since Hong Yi has left Japan and Joon Go. Nearing thirty, Hong Yi works at her father's publishing firm and has spent the last few years trying to forget. But when Joon Go, now a famous writer, comes to Korea to promote his new book, Hong Yi confronts past memories of love, yearning, and heartbreak. When they finally meet, it's as if no time has passed at all. Both lovers are still trapped in old memories.

dramas.name: Bad Guy
dramas.summary: Ji Woon goes to a café after receiving a call from his ex-boyfriend Tae Ha. Ji Woon, who is waiting for his ex with excitement, wondering if anything will happen, hears from Tae Ha that he is getting married to So Hee. Ji Woon is shocked and disappointed, but Tae Ha smiles regardless. Ji Woon then feels a burning desire for revenge on Tae Ha.

dramas.name: Cinderella at 2 AM
dramas.summary: A drama about the love story of Ha Yoon Seo, a realist who believes that there is no Cinderella in reality, and Seo Joo Won, a romanticist who believes that conditions are not important in front of love.

dramas.name: Queen Woo
dramas.summary: Upon the announcement of the king's death in Goguryeo, a fierce battle ensues among tribes. Queen Woo, who immediately becomes the target of princes and five tribes vying for the throne, struggles to crown a new king within 24 hours. Will Queen Woo be able to transcend the constraints of gender and era to carve out her own destiny?

dramas.name: Dear Hyeri
dramas.summary: Ju Eun-ho is an unknown announcer with 14 years of experience. She struggles to get the chance to have her name recognized by the public. She also has another personality, Ju Hae-ri, due to a deep wound in her heart. Her alter-ego, Ju Hae-ri, is super positive and works as a parking attendant. Jeong Hyun-oh is Ju Eun-ho's ex-boyfriend; they dated for a long time but broke up. He became a star announcer as soon as he joined the broadcasting station and is the most-liked announcer by the public, but Jeong Hyun-oh also carries a hidden wound in his mind that he has never shown to anyone. Somehow, Ju Eun-ho and Jeong Hyun-oh reunite and help cure each other's wounds.

dramas.name: Tempest
dramas.summary: A former diplomat uncovers a conspiracy that threatens the stability of the Korean Peninsula.

dramas.name: Dog Knows Everything
dramas.summary: A situational comedy-drama about seniors and Sophie, a former police dog growing old together

dramas.name: The Judge from Hell
dramas.summary: Kang Bit-na is a strikingly beautiful judge, but beneath her flawless exterior, she hides a dark secret — she is a demon. Her mission is to hunt down and kill evil people who lead other people to their deaths and don't reflect on their actions and are unforgivable. After executing her judgment, she condemns their souls to Hell. However, her life takes an unexpected turn when she encounters Han Da-on, a detective with a warm and gentle demeanor. As a detective, his mind is sharp and he has a keen sense of observation. Despite his outward kindness, Han Da-on harbors deep, unseen pain. Their meeting sets off a series of events that profoundly alters both of their lives.

dramas.name: Seoul Blues
dramas.summary: Jung Ha,  Dae Young, and Min Ji, have been close friends since childhood. One day, the three of them were drinking together, and Dae Young confessed to Jung Ha that he liked him. However, Jung Ha was caught off guard and rejected Dae Young's feelings. Afterward, Dae Young showed up saying that he was dating Min Ji. Jung Ha was surprised by Dae Young's unexpected behaviour, but he tried his best to maintain their friendship.

dramas.name: Seoul Busters
dramas.summary: The nation's lowest ranking violent crimes squad and the most elite violent crimes team leader work together to become the strongest team.

dramas.name: The Trunk
dramas.summary: A secret marriage service is uncovered when a trunk washes up on the shore, revealing the strange marriage between a couple in the thick of it all.

dramas.name: Mr. Queen: Bamboo Forest
dramas.summary: In these spin-off miniseries, the viewers get to watch some secret stories of the beloved characters of Mr. Queen. Find out about the first encounter between So Yong and King Cheol Jong, the competitive relationship between Byeong In and Prince Yeong Pyeong, and Lady Hwa Jin's secret that steals the hearts of all the women in the palace.

dramas.name: Love in the Apocalypse
dramas.summary: There's a 99.2% chance the world will end in 7 days. Hee Su decides to come out to his parents and get to know his crush, U Jin. U Jin believes that since there's a 0.8% chance the world won't end, life should go on as normal.

dramas.name: The Time of Fever
dramas.summary: The story follows about two boys, Ho Tae and Dong Hee, who grow up together in Gangneung but are separated when Ho Tae moves to Seoul. After Dong Hee comes out to his family and is subsequently kicked out of his home, he finds refuge in Ho Tae's empty house. When Ho Tae returns to Gangneung for his father's funeral, the two reunite and begin living together, soon realizing that their feelings for each other have always gone beyond friendship or brotherhood.

dramas.name: Love in the Big City
dramas.summary: An audacious tale of two roommates, one a homosexual man and another a heterosexual woman. Through the eyes of Mi Ae begins Go Yeong's clumsy love story. Stories of laughter, tears, and wounds between a mother in denial of his gender identity and a lover unable to escape societal judgment. Go Yeong finally meets a pure love like no other, Gyu Ho, but has no choice but to let him go. With Gyu Ho gone, Go Yeong follows a stranger to Thailand and spends a late monsoon vacation. Reminiscing about the good old days that can never be retrieved, he achieves complete personal growth.

dramas.name: Let Free the Curse of Taekwondo
dramas.summary: Juyoung reunites with his long-lost first love, Dohoi, whom he has been desperately searching for, at a funeral after twelve years. "It feels like everything is cursed…" Twelve years ago, the two of them shared a tender love, empathizing with each other's wounds. How did they end up estranged from each other? Dohoi, who found his own dream instead of Taekwondo as he desired, and Juyoung, who still does Taekwondo, can break the curse of the past now, twelve years later?

dramas.name: Scandal
dramas.summary: Ha Eun Joong, a detective at Gangnam Police station. He became a detective to try to understand his dad better, who was an ex-detective. However, he discovers that his father, Myung Geun, actually kidnapped him when he was a child. Myung Geun had lost his own son in a building collapse, and as revenge against the man responsible, Jang Tae Ha, he abducted Tae Ha's son and raised him as his own. In the aftermath of revenge, Eun Joong searches for the truth and becomes caught between his two fathers and the woman he loves, Woo Ah Mi.

dramas.name: Family By Choice
dramas.summary: Yoon Ju-won is a bright, down-to-earth girl who lives with her single father, Yoon Jeong-jae, when Kim San-ha and Kang Hae-jun, two boys from complicated circumstances, come into her life. Her father takes in the boys to grow up together as a family. Despite being unrelated by blood, Ju-won adores San-ha and Hae-jun and thinks of them as her brothers, no matter how differently others think or say. They reunite after a decade apart - facing new dynamics, unresolved pain and the complexities of adulthood.

dramas.name: Fragile
dramas.summary: Fragile captures the realistic concerns and daily lives of "fragile" teenagers without any hesitation. Shows the taboos that adolescents face during their final teenage years before becoming adults, such as dangerous love with a friend of the opposite sex and risky deviations that they enjoy while avoiding the eyes of adults.

dramas.name: Jeongnyeon: The Star is Born
dramas.summary: Jeong Nyeon has no money or education, but she is a Mokpo girl with a talent for singing! Her dream is to join a women's traditional theater company, and make it big. But she has a lot to learn and a long way to go before becoming a lead actor. Will Jeong Nyeon achieve her dream of becoming a big star and getting rich?

dramas.name: The Secret of Male Students
dramas.summary: Ji Won has the ability to read other peoples minds. However, when he encounters Si Woo, he discovers that Si Woo is the one person whose thoughts remain a mystery to him.

dramas.name: My Man's Man
dramas.summary: College sweethearts Gina and Minwoo, are always with Minwoo's friend, Wan, who might have feelings for Minwoo.

dramas.name: Rule #1: No Dating
dramas.summary: Rookie idol group Deep Blue faces a crisis amid leader Jeongwoo and Junhee's secret romance and conflicts with Alex.

dramas.name: Falling for my BOSS
dramas.summary: Lee Joon, the owner of a flower shop, worries that his shop will be endangered by his in-house romance, but he is also confused by Eun-ho's presence that is deeply rooted in his heart.

dramas.name: Iron Family
dramas.summary: Cheongryeom Laundry has been run by Lee Da-Rim's family for 3 generations. Her family has enough money that they can iron out their dreams instead of being worried. Seo Kang-Joo is the son of the wealthiest family in the Cheongryeom neighborhood. He works as a senior director of the Jiseung Group. 8 years ago, Seo Kang-Joo and Lee Da-Rim attended the same university. Prior to enlisting in the military, he had an unforgettable experience with Lee Da-Rim.Now, Seo Kang-Joo reunites with Lee Da-Rim and gets involved with her. Since she was in her teens, Lee Da-Rim's eyesight has deteriorated and she had limited vision. After turning 30 years old, Lee Da-Rim completely lost her vision, but there is hope that she will be able to see again. An injection that is extremely expensive may give her vision back.

dramas.name: A Virtuous Business
dramas.summary: In search of purpose, opportunity and independence, four rural women start an adult products business in 1992 — embarking on a journey of self-discovery.

dramas.name: Doubt
dramas.summary: Jang Tae Su is a legendary criminal profiler in Korea. He was one of the first in his field and paved the way for criminal behavior analysts in the country. He has gained the absolute respect and trust within the police organization. At home, he is a single parent and raises his daughter by himself. Jang Tae Su works on a murder case and realizes that his daughter is involved in the case. The discovery shakes everything in his professional beliefs and his relationship with his daughter. To protect his daughter, Jang Tae Su struggles to reveal the truth.

dramas.name: My Merry Marriage
dramas.summary: By showing various aspects of marriage such as divorce, remarriage, and graduation, it asks about the true meaning of 'happiness'. A delightful family drama that will resonate and laughter across all generations.

dramas.name: Brewing Love
dramas.summary: Chae Yong-ju is a former member of the special forces in the military. She's physically and mentally strong and has her own unique cheerfulness. She is also good at hiding her true emotions. Now working as a salesperson for a liquor company for the past six years, she has been dubbed the sales king. Despite her dedication, her branch is on the verge of closing. To avoid the closure, she carries out a mission to sell a new beer made by brewmaster & CEO of the brewery company, Yun Min-ju. Min-ju is a sensitive man good at sensing other people's emotions. He lives in a peaceful, quiet rural area to focus on making beer. When Yong-ju appears in front of him, however, his life is about to change.

dramas.name: Good Boy
