dramas.summary: A comical action youth investigative drama in which medalists who became police officers as special recruits from the Olympics wear police ID cards around their necks instead of medals and fight against a world rife with unscrupulousness and foul play.

dramas.name: My Damn Business
dramas.summary: Sales Team 2 receives notification of dissolution amidst the company's management crisis. Left alone, Team Leader Han must wrap up business with partner companies that he has managed within three months. Yun, an assistant manager from the support team, is dispatched to Sales Team 2. With just the two of them in the empty office, Han can't help but notice Yun's aloof demeanor. A small incident leads to changes between the two.

dramas.name: Mr. Plankton
dramas.summary: Lee Yoo Mi stars as a bride-to-be whose medical conditions threatens her marriage to a family obsessed with continuing their grand lineage.

dramas.name: Cashero
dramas.summary: An ordinary man who inherits super strength discovers a greater evil out to steal his power. The one catch? Every use drains money from his wallet.

dramas.name: Genie, Make a Wish
dramas.summary: A woman becomes the master of a genie who keeps tempting her to make a wish — sparking a risky, magical connection.

dramas.name: Can This Love Be Translated?
dramas.summary: The emotions of a celebrity and her interpreter get lost in translation as they travel the world filming a TV show. Will love find its own language?

dramas.name: The Price of Confession
dramas.summary: Accused of killing her husband, a woman is offered a way out by a mysterious stranger: in exchange for a confession in her place, she must commit murder.

dramas.name: Good or Bad Dong Jae
dramas.summary: Seo Dong Jae is a prosecutor and works in the Cheongju District Prosecutors' Office. He is ambitious and places a priority on his success as a prosecutor. Nevertheless, he is not completely cold hearted as a person. Due to the label given to him as a corrupt prosecutor, his future as a prosecutor is not bright at all. While mired in trouble over a redevelopment case, he takes on a high school student murder case. He begins to walk a fine line between his intuition as a prosecutor and instinct as an opportunist.This is a spin-off of "Stranger" (2017) drama.

dramas.name: Our Beautiful Summer
dramas.summary: The story of A Reum, Da Un, Yu Ri and our three siblings who were born as quadruplets and lost the youngest, Na Ra, and became three, and the lonely summer when no one was there, meeting and falling in love again and becoming happy.

dramas.name: Love Your Enemy
dramas.summary: A reunion romance that takes place over 15 years when two men and women, who loved each other passionately when they were in school but had to make a painful breakup due to antagonism between families and the mischief of fate, meet again.

dramas.name: The Tale of Lady Ok
dramas.summary: A work that contains the fierce survival and success of a female slave during the Joseon Dynasty, and depicts the story of a woman whose name, status, and even her husband are fake.

dramas.name: Taming the Bad Boy
dramas.summary: From his very first day at his new school, Jin-woo draws everyone's attention. Among them is Tae-seop, who approaches Jin-woo out of curiosity. As his curiosity grows uncontrollable, rumors begin spreading at school about who might be gay… "From now on, you're my little pet."

dramas.name: Blue Complex
dramas.summary: After leaving diving behind due to a traumatic experience, Im Pa-rang, a former silver medalist, joins the university swimming team. There, he finds himself caught in a complex journey of love and self-discovery with two men, Taemin and Yubin.

dramas.name: Red Whisper
dramas.summary: The story centers on Suyol, who is deeply committed to her relationship with Ajin. However, unbeknownst to her, Ajin is secretly having with an affair with a man named Jaehyun. As Suyol remains blissfully unaware of the betrayal, her close friend Harry struggles with her own hidden feelings for Suyol. Will Suyol's world come crashing down when she discovers the truth about Ajin's affair? And could this painful revelation open the door for Harry to finally confess her love?

dramas.name: Tendering Resignation
dramas.summary: The drama follows Oh Geumhui, a hardworking woman who sometimes comes across as a workaholic. She leads a seemingly normal life, working at her longtime close friend Kang Taeri's company. When a new employee mistakenly assumes she and Taeri are lesbians and quits, the competent Yu Bora steps in. As strange events unfold, the trio discovers that Nosong Group is behind it all. How will they navigate these challenges together?

dramas.name: Nineteen
dramas.summary: The story captures the essence of teenage years, portraying the most vivid and unforgettable moments of a young girl's life. It delves into the excitement and emotions of first love, as 19-year-old girls navigate the complexities of friendship and romance, experiencing those indescribable feelings that come with growing up.

dramas.name: Marry You
dramas.summary: Level seven government worker Jung Ha-na's dream is to retire peacefully, but her feisty attitude lands her in the Marriage Promotion Team at Injeong City Hall, a role she finds baffling as she doesn't believe in marriage herself. To make matters worse, her ex-boyfriend Ki-jun, whom she nearly married three years ago, appears as her new team leader, adding to her disbelief. Desperate to escape the team, Ha-na is tasked with marrying off local bachelor Cheol-hee. Though Cheol-hee initially refuses, believing he's not suited for marriage, Ha-na's determination gradually softens his heart. As they open up to each other, Ha-na and Cheol-hee, who both doubted their worthiness of marriage, find themselves questioning if they can take the plunge after all. Will Ha-na and Cheol-hee finally gather the courage to believe in love and marriage?

dramas.name: Face Me
dramas.summary: A medical mystery thriller that traces the truth of the incident of a famous plastic surgeon, who had a reputation as a righteous man, who fell into the abyss after being caught up in an unexpected incident and underwent reconstructive plastic surgery for crime victims.

dramas.name: Parole Examiner Lee
dramas.summary: Parole Examiner Lee follows lawyer Lee Han Shin, who becomes a parole officer responsible for making final decisions on inmate paroles. Lee Han Shin is determined to prevent inmates who show little remorse for their crimes from obtaining paroles through money, connections, or deceitful tactics.

dramas.name: Family Planning
dramas.summary: A group of people possessing special abilities disguise themselves as a family to survive against heinous criminals. Han Yeong Su is a loving mother with a special ability. Baek Cheol Hui is a father who hides his special ability. He has a timid personality, but he loves his wife, Yeong Su, a lot. Baek Gang Seong is a grandfather who shows an abrupt manner, but he cares for his family a lot. Baek Ji Hun and Baek Ji U are 17-year-old brother and sister. Ji Hun has a warm and gentle personality, while Ji U is picky and sensitive.

dramas.name: Hyper Knife
dramas.summary: Jung Se Ok, a formerly successful neurosurgeon who works as a shadow doctor in an underground surgery clinic after being expelled by her mentor, Choi Duk Hee. Soon, both doctors reunite, reigniting a tense and emotional rivalry.

dramas.name: Social Savvy Class 101
dramas.summary: A high-teen secret romance unfolds when 'Outsider' (an outsider) becomes the manager of the anonymous community app 'Inssa Time' and learns all the secrets of the entire school and joins a group of super popular kids that she desperately wants to get involved with. Kang U Bin is a popular kid among the popular kids and a trainee at a large entertainment agency who is admired by the entire school and is seen as perfect by his classmates. He not only has great visuals but is also good at studying. He seems like a born-to-be superstar who exceeds the webtoon's setting, but he is hiding a secret that no one can find out about. U Bin, who has never been suspected, ends up in an awkward situation because of 'Outssa', whose name is even confusing.

dramas.name: Recipient
dramas.summary: High school student Sung Seo Yun feels unwanted by her abusive, dysfunctional family. She longs for the means to escape them all, so she buys lottery tickets. One day she wins the ₩5 billion grand prize, but discovers that minors are ineligible to play or collect the winnings. She turns to an older recent transfer student from a rich family for help.

dramas.name: Sorry Not Sorry
dramas.summary: Dumped overnight, Ji Song Yi is left burdened by the difficulties of single life, part-time jobs, and paying off her newlywed home loan. She keeps up the ruse of being a happily married woman to save herself from being estranged from the married townswomen.

dramas.name: Buddy Boy
dramas.summary: Yuho, an 18-year-old boy who took refuge in a quiet rural village due to his parents' bankruptcy.Even at a glance, Yuho exudes the image of a boy who grew up only in the city.While walking along the valley path and meditating, he spots a girl (Lina) and a boy (Jin Goo) who appear to be around the same age splashing in the water.Yuho sees beauty and a strange excitement for the first time in his life as he sees their sparkling figures together with Yunseul in the valley...

dramas.name: Way Back Love
dramas.summary: The Grim Reaper appears as the person you love the most before you die. In front of 24-year-old Hee Wan who had no will to carry on and lived as a social outcast, her childhood friend as well as her first love Ram Woo appears as a Grim Reaper and tells her she will die in a week. Hee Wan and Ram Woo are forced to spend a week together. Throughout their time together, they rediscover the meaning of life and reconnect with what truly matters.

dramas.name: The WONDERfools
dramas.summary: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.

dramas.name: Check in Hanyang
dramas.summary: A drama about Yongcheonru, the largest guest inn of Joseon, with the unspoken value 'guests are kings', and the Joseon flower youths who joined the company as educational envoys who were hired by the government office to do small things.

dramas.name: Who Is She
dramas.summary: A romantic music coming-of-age drama about grandmother Oh Mal Soon, who turns into a 20-year-old Oh Doo Ri overnight and enjoys her shining prime once again.

dramas.name: Namib
dramas.summary: After being fired for her past mistakes, former entertainment company CEO Kang Soo-hyun is offered a severance package to buy out her longtime trainee, Yoo Jin-woo. Soo-hyun decides to train Jin-woo well and sell him to another company so that she can buy a factory for her disabled child. At first, she only thinks of her own child and tries to make Jin-woo successful, but as time goes by, she helps him sincerely.

dramas.name: Love Scout
dramas.summary: A successful and confident woman, Kang Ji Yun, is the CEO of a headhunting company. To survive in the fiercely competitive headhunting field, she puts everything she has into her work. Outside of her job, she doesn't know how to do anything. She has a secretary named Yoo Eun Ho who takes care of pretty much everything for her. Unlike his boss, the secretary is friendly, well-mannered, and considerate of other people. He is a single father, who is also good at parenting and housework.

dramas.name: Match Play
dramas.summary: I teach 'Jaeyeon', a stuntman who quietly sticks to his principles, and 'Doha', an idol who was cast in an action movie, but he is arbitrarily proud and does not listen. However, Jae-yeon, who is just as stubborn, and Do-ha, who uses tricks, are trained without much effort, and the two eventually become enemies. Then one day, the two bickering as usual was filmed on idol content, and Jaeyeon gains mysterious popularity... and an unexpected situation begins!

dramas.name: Cinderella Game
dramas.summary: A woman was used as a fake daughter by her enemy and became the embodiment of revenge. She grows and heals as she realizes the true meaning of revenge.

dramas.name: Motel California
dramas.summary: Ji Gang Hui grew up at Motel California because her father ran the motel in her rural hometown village. Her mother also came from a mixed-raced background. Due to Gang Hui's unusual family background, she was the object of whispers and gossip by the local residents. Gang Hui carried a deep wound in her heart from that time. She liked her childhood friend Cheon Yeon Su, who was her first love, but when she turned 20, she left her hometown and moved to Seoul. 12 years later, she works as an interior designer and is reaching the apex of her career, but, for some reason, she decides to return to her hometown. She reunites with her first love, Cheon Yeon Su. Cheon Yeon Su works as a veterinarian in the village. The only woman he has loved is Gang Hui, but he has received a lot of attention from the farmers who are eager to introduce him to their daughters. In order to avoid these kind of uncomfortable situations, he doesn't clarify the rumor that he is going to marry a fellow veterinarian. His first love Gang Hui appears again after 12 years.

dramas.name: The Witch
dramas.summary: Dong Jin is recognized as the best in the field of data mining. The reason he majored in statistics at his university was because of Mi Jung and his wish to help her. Dong Jin and Mi Jung attended the same high school and he had crush on her, but she was called a witch. Since Mi Jung was little, strange things occurred around her like all the guys who liked her died or got injured. 10 years after school graduation, Dong Jin happens to meet Mi Jung again. She has now cut herself off from the world, believing her fate is cursed, but she wants to go out into the world. In hopes of Mi Jung breaking out of her shell, Dong in wants to prove that all these unfortunate incidents are not because of her. To prove his thesis, he investigates all the situations when guys around her got hurt. Risking his life, he finally finds the law of misfortune around her.

dramas.name: The Queen Who Crowns
dramas.summary: Queen Won Kyung, born to Min Je during the Goryeo period, came from a prestigious family of high-ranking officials. Married to Lee Bang Won, son of King Taejo, she supported her husband's ambitions to become King Taejong after his father bypassed him for the throne. As a kingmaker, she helped establish a new regime. However, their relationship soured after Lee Bang Won became king, took concubines, and sought to curb Queen Won Kyung's influence and that of her family.

dramas.name: You Want Some?
dramas.summary: Seonwoo, a man with an irresistible charm that leaves every girl bewitched and eager to confess, meets Jaeheon, who unexpectedly finds himself falling helplessly for him. Their story begins with a playful rivalry sparked by a daring bet—who will confess their feelings to the other person first.

dramas.name: Trigger
dramas.summary: An action thriller drama that depicts what happens when guns of unknown origin are unleashed in South Korea, a gun-free country, and guns are given to angry people one by one.

dramas.name: I Love You Bit by Bit
Perfect Crown
dramas.summary: Welcome to 21st-century Korea, a constitutional monarchy where tradition and modernity intertwine in style, and glamour masks a rigid social hierarchy. Seong Huiju, a brilliant chaebol heiress and CEO, seems to have everything. Yet as a commoner by birth, she is always denied the respect she deserves. When her family begins relentlessly pushing her toward future marriage prospects, Huiju grows determined to take control of her own future after she crosses paths with Grand Prince lan at the Imperial Birthday Banquet. She has everything but status, whereas he has nothing but status. Together, they enter a contract marriage of the century. But can they break societal barriers and carve out their own destinies?

dramas.name: Newtopia
dramas.summary: Set in an air defense unit in a high-rise building in Seoul, the drama depicts the process of a soldier, Jae-yoon, and his girlfriend, Yeong-joo, who have just been notified of a breakup, running toward each other while fighting a horde of zombies.

dramas.name: Oh My Ghost Clients
dramas.summary: Mu-jin is a labor attorney who gets paid for covering up the corruption of problematic companies while visiting labor sites with high industrial accident risks. One day, during an inspection of a factory, he faces a near-death crisis when steel materials collapse. At that moment, a Bodhisattva with a burning labor law book in hand appears before Mu-jin and forces him to sign a labor contract. Then, Mu-jin gains the ability to see ghosts, and to save his own life he also must solve various labor problems brought by the ghosts and resolve their grudges.

dramas.name: Study Group
dramas.summary: It follows the life of student Yoon Ga Min, who wants to be good at studying but is only good at fighting, as he forms a study group at the worst school on earth and tells a fierce story about college entrance exams. Yoon Ga Min, who looks like a model student but is a student of Yusung Technical High School, which is one of the worst schools to study at. Although he studies extremely hard, his grades don't rise in the slightest. Despite all that, Yoon Ga Min sits diligently at his desk with the goal of going to college. However, when his study group friends get bullied, Yoon Ga Min takes off his glasses and school uniform jacket to put his fighting skills to use. Lee Han Kyeong, Yoon Ga Min's teacher, dreams of seeing the school change for the better. Lee Han Kyeong tutored Yoon Ga Min during her university days and reunites with him when she is appointed as a temporary teacher, holding a secret.

dramas.name: Nine Puzzles
dramas.summary: After discovering the body of her murdered uncle, Yoon Ena becomes a profiler to uncover the truth behind what happened that night. A decade later, Detective Hansaem still suspects Ena was responsible, and when a series of murders begins to occur, each linked to a corresponding puzzle piece, Hansaem will follow his instincts to track down the killer.

dramas.name: In the Room
dramas.summary: At Kamikei Gakuen, Tenma Ryo serves as a counselor, listening to students, teachers, and parents seeking help with their issues. Despite their reluctance and attempts to conceal their concerns, Ryo's unique approach gently and sometimes boldly exposes their underlying troubles, mending their emotional wounds. While perceived as a highly-skilled psychiatrist by his peers, Ryo grapples with his own inner demons. His choice of profession and the significance of mending hearts raise questions about his motivations and past.

dramas.name: The Scandal of Chunhwa
dramas.summary: Set in the fictional country of Dongbangguk. Hwari is youngest princess of the royal family. She grew up with an independent mindset. When she reaches the age to marry, she decides to find her husband by herself. She comes out of the palace to meet her suitors. She also tries to find the person who painted her face as the main female character in a series of erotic chunhwa paintings.Meanwhile, Choi Hwan is first on the list of potential husbands for Princess Hwari. He is the wealthiest merchant and possesses a handsome appearance. He looks like a man who enjoys women and money, but he seems to hide a secret.

dramas.name: Made in Korea
dramas.summary: In 1970s South Korea a man determined to reach the pinnacle of wealth and power lives a double life - KCIA agent by day and dangerous business man by night. Determined and unstoppable, he comes face to face with a tenacious prosecutor willing to risk it all to bring him down.

dramas.name: Buried Hearts
dramas.summary: To survive, a man hacked into a political slush fund worth 2 trillion won. The other man is a powerful shadowy figure, who loses 2 trillion won by killing a man without knowing that he was hacked.

dramas.name: Low Life
dramas.summary: A man and his uncle are offered to find a bowl relic in the West Sea, and they jump into a treasure hunt to escape from their lives of selling fakes. As more and more people search for the treasure, their obsessions become mad and they are forced to make choices between desire and humanity.

dramas.name: The Murky Stream
dramas.summary: A gripping tale of twisted fates unfolds in lawless Joseon, where the once-pristine Gyeonggang River has turned into a murky stream. Jang Si Yul, a man who buries his past to survive as a gangster, Choi Eun, a sharp-minded and righteous soul, and Jung Chun, an idealist striving to become an honest official, find their destinies entangled in a world where justice is scarce, and survival comes at a cost.

dramas.name: The Haunted Palace
dramas.summary: Born with shamanic powers that she refuses to accept, a young woman confronts her gift to rid the Joseon palace of evil spirits and save her first love.

dramas.name: The Art of Negotiation
dramas.summary: Yoon Joo-no, a key figure in the former M&A Team of SANIN GROUP, suddenly disappeared one day, leaving for Hawaii for undisclosed reasons. Rumors spread that he had been demoted, but the truth remains unknown to anyone. Then, three years later, when SANIN GROUP is facing bankruptcy with 11 billion dollars in debt, he is called back to Korea as their last hope. His mission is clear: to save SANIN GROUP. However, his solution is far from straightforward. Gaining the support of CEO Song Jae-sik, he forms a new M&A Team and gathers the best negotiators to dive into the perilous world of high-stakes deals. With his team, Joo-no takes one last gamble. Can he secure the 11 billion dollars needed to save the company, or will even the so-called "god of negotiation" be brought down?

dramas.name: Knock Off
dramas.summary: Kim Seong-Jun (Kim Soo-Hyun) is regular office worker, but, after the IMF crisis, he lost his job and began working the counterfeit market. He begins to work as the vice chairman of a counterfeit producing company and grows the company into one of the largest counterfeiters in the world. He relies on his intelligence, quick response to unexpected situations, and a strong desire for success to become the king of the counterfeit market.Meanwhile, Song Hye-Jeong (Jo Bo-Ah) is Kim Seong-Jun's ex-girlfriend and she works as a special judicial police officer, whose job is to crack down on counterfeit goods. Kim Seong-Jun and Song Hye-Jeong form a tense relationship surrounding the crackdown of counterfeit goods.

dramas.name: Walking on Thin Ice
dramas.summary: A human thriller that takes place when a housewife in her 40s with a sick husband accidentally picks up drugs that fell on the road.

dramas.name: Queen Mantis
dramas.summary: A thriller that follows a woman who was imprisoned as a serial killer a long time ago, and someone begins a serial killing imitating her.

dramas.name: Gangster Like Me Got a Boyfriend
dramas.summary: Yunho, a young man who failed to debut, receives a surprising offer: a three-month dating proposal from Jaeho, a gangster. As Yunho starts to open his heart to Jaeho, who appeared at a critical moment to save him, danger looms as those targeting Jaeho begin to approach him…

dramas.name: My Dearest Nemesis
dramas.summary: As a high school senior, Su-Jeong began playing an online game where she met another player nicknamed "Black Dragon". They unexpectedly got close, developing crushes and planning a meeting in real life… that concluded in humiliation and disaster when "Black Dragon" turned out to be an awkward middle schooler instead of the young man he portrayed himself to be! Sixteen years later, Su-Jeong is a skilled planner at Yongseong Department Store, but her job is about to get a shakeup with the arrival of Ban Ju-Yeon, the ambitious new head of strategic planning and heir to the company. There's just one problem: Ban Ju-Yeon is actually "Black Dragon", and Su-Jeong still holds a grudge. Will their past come back to haunt them, or can they find a way to resolve their misunderstandings – and even find love as adults?

dramas.name: The Potato Lab
dramas.summary: In The Potato Lab, Mi Kyung's potato-centric life is upended by Baek Ho, a cold pragmatist. A whirlwind healing romantic comedy unfolds, as twisty as a tornado potato.

dramas.name: Melo Movie
dramas.summary: Even if hardship and misfortune always accompany life, the youths who have walked with their middle finger raised now seek someone to lean on wholeheartedly, wanting to find a person to rely on as if they were to fall. Dreaming of becoming a film director one day, Kim Moo Bi, an assistant director, wants to follow in her father's footsteps, who worked as a filming crew member. After entering the film industry, she quietly honed her skills, not drawing attention to herself in the eyes of others. On the other hand, Ko Gyeom rose from being a supporting actor to becoming a film critic. He meets Moo Bi on the set of an interview film, eventually starting their own love story.

dramas.name: FC Soldout
dramas.summary: FC Soldout is about a soccer team that is not doing well, one day it is bought by a agency, the reason for the acquisition is just to commoditize the team to make money again, the agency takes over and cuts out all the players with poor face，then forces the actors with face value from their agency to become players.

dramas.name: Kick Kick Kick Kick
dramas.summary: A comedy-drama about a star story that takes place in establishing and running a new content production company by an entertainment producer and a once-popular actor.

dramas.name: For Eagle Brothers
dramas.summary: The story of the eldest sister-in-law, who becomes the breadwinner after her husband's sudden death 10 days after marriage, and five brothers with a brewery that has been manufacturing traditional liquor for three generations.

dramas.name: Friendly Rivalry
dramas.summary: Woo Seul-Ki grew up in an orphanage out in a province. She moves to Seoul and enrolls in Chaehwa High School, which is a school for the top 1% students in South Korea. Woo Seul-Ki doesn't get along with the other students. A student named Yoo Je-Yi approaches her and they become friends.Yoo Je-Yi is the most powerful student in the school. She has a high IQ, comes from a wealthy family background, and is attractive physically. She has lived as the envy of other people since she was born and she is aware of her superiority. She is also cunning enough to know how to take advantage of her position. She shows special interest in transfer student Woo Seul-Ki. They soon develop a dangerous relationship between friendship and obsession.

dramas.name: Heart Stain
dramas.summary: "Let's date until we graduate."Woohyun has a secret crush on his homeroom teacher. His best friend, Doha, finds out and confesses his feelings for him. But then he makes an interesting proposition: "Go out with me. Fall for me before graduation, and I win. If you don't, you win." Can Woohyun like someone other than his teacher?

dramas.name: Secret Relationships
dramas.summary: Daon, a smart and handsome salary man, often clashes with his colleague Sunghyeon. Their relationship becomes more and more ambiguous as time progresses, while other figures like Jaemin, a former tutor, and heir to the company Suhyeon make their way into his life. What shape will this love square end up turning into?

dramas.name: The Queen Who Crowns: Before Sunrise
dramas.summary: A romance drama depicting the fateful first meeting between 'Won Kyung', who dreamed of a new world before embracing the world, and 'Bang Won', who shared the same aspirations as her.

dramas.name: Tale of the Nine Tailed: An Unfinished Story
dramas.summary: The 3 episode spinoff will tell the story of Lee Rang and Ki Yoo Ri before and during the events of "Tale of the Nine-Tailed."

dramas.name: Only for Fans
dramas.summary: Danny, a content creator running an independent online channel, receives an unexpected proposal from Ho Yeon, a long-time fan.

dramas.name: Checkered Shirt
dramas.summary: A casual purchase of a Checkered Shirt through Karrot Market leads to an unexpected connection with a mysterious man, sparking curiosity and unspoken emotions. Jungwoo experiences lingering feelings and encounters new possibilities.

dramas.name: TwosomeBoys
dramas.summary: Despite the setback of not debuting with his original group and the emotional baggage he carries, Kang Min continues to practice relentlessly. He faces pressure to succeed, with reminders of his peers already debuting and achieving their dreams. One such day of practicing lends him a long overdue reunion with an ex-boyfriend of his - Su Ho, who used to train alongside Kang Min but is now a debuted idol, looking to practice in the dance room with his other two group members. Storming past the idols, Kang Min leaves the dance room, with Su Ho tailing behind hoping to make amends. Su Ho's attempts at reconciliation are met with anger and resentment, "Who can forget being betrayed by the person they trusted the most? How could that memory go away?"

dramas.name: Influencer lover
dramas.summary: Couple influencers, Eun Seong and Ji Yeon, have only dated for 3 months, but thanks to the algorithm, their popularity skyrocketed. Now broken up, they've been pretending to be a couple for 6 months! Just when everything seemed stable, Gang U enters the picture, leaving Eun Seong torn between his influencer life and true love.

dramas.name: Accent
dramas.summary: Having lived his entire life as a piano prodigy, Dong Uk finds himself envying Seong Hun's superior talent - but at the same time, he falls in love with him.

dramas.name: All for you
dramas.summary: A sweet romance between the president and the staff.

dramas.name: Mother and Mom
dramas.summary: The life of a three-generation mother-daughter in Daechi-dong, where Jung Eun, an avid working mother, prepares for her daughter's '7th birthday' and entrusts Ji Ah to drive her to school.

dramas.name: Our Chocolate Moments
dramas.summary: Seul Gi gets a job at a chocolate shop and, no matter how hard she tries, she can't seem to adapt to the environment. Despite trying to overcome her alienation with positivity, she always ends up getting hurt. One day, at Honggeumdang, a place she visited to fix a broken watch, Seul Gi falls in love with the charm of whiskey and artisanal chocolate. With this in mind, she becomes the only member of a task force that will participate in an internal Valentine's Day contest. She starts collaborating with the owner of Honggeumdang to create the best chocolate ever, but ends up having trouble finding teammates. That's when Hyun Nam, a chocolate freak, and Jeremy, an outgoing influencer, show up. Now, this trio and Mr. Hong, who is nice in a weird way, will have the chance to create the best Valentine's Day chocolate.

dramas.name: Running Mate
dramas.summary: Se Hoon is a model student with good grades, but an unfortunate incident on the bus one day earns him the humiliating nickname of ‘Erector.' The choir director, Won Dae, asks him to be his running mate for the upcoming student council election. Needing to rehabilitate his image, Se Hoon agrees, only to find out that he is Won Dae's twelfth running mate. With his pride bruised, Se Hoon decides to join Sang Hyun, a walking luxury man known as the local social butterfly.

dramas.name: The Divorce Insurance
dramas.summary: A drama that contains the explicit process of putting a value on divorce, such as developing a new divorce insurance product by an insurance company's innovative product development team, which is comprised of only the best brains, quantifying all matters related to divorce and determining the appropriate insurance amount.

dramas.name: Villains Everywhere
dramas.summary: A family comedy situation drama about middle-aged K-sisters, their husbands, and their children living together in a world overflowing with villains.

dramas.name: The Good Man
dramas.summary: Seok-cheol, the eldest son in a family of three generations of gangsters, navigates the tumultuous ups and downs of life with tears and laughter, all to protect his family, career, and love.

dramas.name: History Of Losers
dramas.summary: A story about love and relationships that could turn anyone into a loser. It will be portrayed in the form of a romantic comedy that shows the inherent pathetic sides of people and diverse thrilling moments that come with various forms of love. The hyperrealistic depiction of humans at their lowest will be accompanied by laughter and empathy that goes beyond discomfort. Seo Min Ki is a freshman in college who is majoring in Korean literature. He is a hesitant person with a lot on his mind who sometimes makes bold actions. Being a 20-year-old, the result of his actions are always a series of clumsiness and mistakes. However, because he's someone who thinks a lot and has an ideological personality, he always self-reflects. He is a simple outsider whose only wish is to drink with his friends and play games at internet cafes.

dramas.name: Crushology 101
dramas.summary: If there were a guide for love, would Bunny not have been a pushover? Although she is crazy over good looks, Bunny believes sincerity is more important when dating. The result? Her first love with terrible looks and an awful personality turns out to be the worst, and she becomes known as a school-wide pushover. With the determination to never fail again, Bunny declares she will no longer act like a doormat and only date alpha males when four outstanding oppas appear before her. Bunny's heart gets no rest amid the endless parade of high-quality flirting, aimed to win her over and become her number one oppa. Is this a guide to stop being a pushover? Or is it a proper dating course for falling in love? Will Bunny the pushover transform into a dating genius?

dramas.name: 24 Health Club
dramas.summary: Do Hyeon-joong was once the star of "Mr. David," the premier bodybuilding competition in the U.S.—until he vanished without a trace. Now he's running a shabby 24-hour gym. After a terrible first night with her boyfriend, followed by an even worse breakup, Mi-ran signs up for Hyeon-joong's expensive personal-training plan, desperate to reboot her life. As Mi-ran fights to get fit and find herself again, Hyeon-joong's own world heads in unexpected directions. Can Hyun-joong prove himself as a rookie gym owner, and will Mi-ran rediscover her spark? Their sweaty, heart-warming reboot begins now.

dramas.name: Summer indigo
dramas.summary: There's one more reason to leave the judo club... Seonwoo wants to leave the judo club, and Taehyung has to stop him A heart-pounding judo club romance

dramas.name: Romeo and Romeo and juliet
dramas.summary: Ji Su's ex-boyfriend, Hui Jun, and child actor, Ju Yeon, are double-cast as Romeo, entangling Juliet Ji Su in a love triangle.

dramas.name: Double play
dramas.summary: As captain, Jeongho is upset when his club gets shut down due to a lack of funding. After negotiating with the school, they are given one last chance. This team can stay active only if they win the next competition. The protagonist must put aside his differences with the star pitcher and work together to save their beloved team.

dramas.name: Sonny's Competition
dramas.summary: After spending one rainy night together, the souls of two Son Jin Us get swapped?! A newbie outcast and a wild team leader—can they survive the chaos of office life?

dramas.name: Heo's Diner
dramas.summary: A fantasy romance that takes place 400 years later when Heo Gyoon, a problematic character from the Joseon Dynasty, moves to the modern world to open a restaurant.

dramas.name: Close to You
dramas.summary: Four Crush Stories

dramas.name: Something Is Not Right
dramas.summary: Where will my suppressed feelings finally burst out go? A romance of unrequited love with different dreams that will lead nowhere!

dramas.name: Business as Unusual
dramas.summary: Kim Minjun is your average 30-year-old office worker. Now that he's older, Minjun is feeling the pressure to accomplish more in life, and he can't shake the feeling that something is missing amidst the monotonous routine of his 9-to-5 job. Out of nowhere, his ex-boyfriend Jinhwan shows up as a new co-worker, looking as handsome and charismatic as ever while Minjun feels like he hasn't progressed at all since their breakup 10 years ago. Determined not to let an ex from a decade ago mess with his work life, Minjun just wants to carry on with business as usual. But it seems that Jinhwan has other plans in mind…

dramas.name: Sweetheart Service
dramas.summary: Fresh graduate Yooha struggles to find a job and takes on gig work to become independent. Meanwhile, workaholic Minwoo, tired of marriage pressure, hires a fake boyfriend for a month. Yooha, exhausted from difficult clients, accepts Minwoo's high-paying offer—with three simple rules: secrecy, two meetings per week, and answering calls when needed. Their contract is clear, but as they continue the act, pretend feelings start to feel real.

dramas.name: Law and the City
dramas.summary: A cheerful and passionate youth drama about associate lawyers who go to work at Seocho-dong Law Town every day. It is a realistic story of 'real' lawyers who have stepped into the real world and will portray the coming of age of lawyers in charge of cases that can happen in and around our daily lives. An Ju Hyeong is a 9th-year lawyer with a high level of fact-violence logic. He became a lawyer simply because he found logic and cases interesting. From the beginning, he did not have the 'meaning' that lawyers protect the weak, implement justice, and change the world. He is just a 9th office worker. He has been a regular at the same company for 9 years without changing jobs, and his work is at its peak as his seniority. He is a veteran in the associate industry who has set a new associate salary record but does not open a practice because it is too much trouble. For Ju Hyeong, the peaceful wall of the 'workplace' begins to crack. Kang Hui Ji is a 2nd-year lawyer at Johwa Law Firm. She believes that " if you change one person's life, you have changed that person's world." Whether she is lacking or overflowing, she is confident and honest.

dramas.name: Teach You a Lesson
dramas.summary: When respect collapses in schools, a special unit arrives to set things right — with sharp, no-nonsense lessons you won't find in textbooks.

dramas.name: The Witch's Eye
dramas.summary: Strange things happen to influencer Han Da Bit from Anyeon University, starting with the nightmare that she has one day. Then one day, she sees Do Hee, a senior she runs into at school, and Da Bit feels a strange attraction. Da Bit, who follows her out of curiosity about Do Hee, enters a unique tarot shop.

dramas.name: Heavenly Ever After
dramas.summary: Upon arriving in heaven at the age of 80, Hae Sook reunites with her rejuvenated husband, Nak Joon, leading to a romance that transcends their earthly lives.

dramas.name: Catch Your Luck
dramas.summary: A drama depicting the turbulent and eventful growth period of three friends; one rich, one poor, and one who wants to be rich, and their families.

dramas.name: Twelve
dramas.summary: Inspired by the 12 zodiac animals of the East, Twelve tells the story of 12 angels living in the human world in human form to protect the Korean Peninsula from evil spirits. Long ago, the angels barely managed to seal the forces of evil in the gates of hell through their sacrifice, bringing peace. However, with the evil spirits awakening, chaos returns.

dramas.name: Queen's House
dramas.summary: A revenge drama about a woman who believed she had a perfect life and then had her life completely stolen from her.

dramas.name: Moon River
dramas.summary: Joseon Crown Prince Lee Gang is known by many as an unserious, pleasure-seeking man, but he uses this facade to mask his deep pain from losing his beloved wife. While his mother tries to find him a new spouse, he's dismissive of her attempts, only wishing to pursue revenge. His life takes a turn when he runs into Park Dal I, a merchant with amnesia who bears a startling resemblance to his wife. Although Dal I and Lee Gang's first meeting goes poorly, they soon find themselves as unlikely allies helping those in need. However, the two awaken one morning to the shock of a lifetime: they've swapped bodies. As Lee Gang and Dal I try to figure out how this happened, they uncover political conspiracies and dangerous secrets – and that their connection might run deeper than they think.

dramas.name: Second Shot at Love
dramas.summary: A story about a woman who was born and raised in a family of alcoholics escaping from her drunkenness. Han Geum Joo is a mechanic who becomes a public servant at a large company because she loves cars. She was called a "woman who drinks better than men," but when she is given another title of "alcoholic," Geum Joo decides to challenge herself by "abstaining from drinking." Seo Ui Joon is a doctor who was on a roll as a specialist at a prestigious university hospital in Seoul but ended up moving down to the rural village of Bocheon Health Center. He believes that alcohol is not a cure but an anesthetic and can ruin your life, and he will likely get involved with Geum Joo, who has been given the title of "alcoholic".

dramas.name: Tastefully Yours
dramas.summary: Tastefully Yours depicts the story of Han Bum Woo, the successor of a large food company, who runs the best fine dining restaurant in Seoul but has no interest in 'taste', and Mo Yun Joo, a chef crazy about 'taste' who runs a one-table restaurant without a sign in a remote corner of the countryside. They grow together and fall in love while running a small restaurant in the city of Miraek, Jeonju.

dramas.name: Spring of Youth
dramas.summary: A musical youth drama where a top K-pop star named Sa Gye is forced to attend a university campus, forming a four-member co-ed band, loving passionately, and growing through music.

dramas.name: Our Unwritten Seoul
dramas.summary: Our Unwritten Seoul centers on twin sisters, Yoo Mi Ji and Yoo Mi Rae — identical in appearance yet opposite in personality and life paths. After a complicated twist of fate, they swap identities, each sister navigating unfamiliar challenges to discover love and their true selves.

dramas.name: The First Night with the Duke
dramas.summary: A handsome, selfish noble falls for a beautiful, kind commoner -- at least, that's how the story's supposed to go. When an average college student wakes up as Cha Sun Chaek, an extra in her favorite romance novel, she resolves to enjoy the luxuries of her character's status while watching the novel's plot unfold from the sidelines.However, her plans are soon derailed when she finds herself in bed with no other than Lee Bun, the novel's hero! Dodging the villainess' schemes, the Duke's advances, and her own feelings, can Sun Chaek keep the story on track and survive beyond the first night?

dramas.name: The Colors of Our Time
dramas.summary: It tells the romance of Yu Ra a web novel writer who planed her new romance novel when she saw by chance the photographer Jung Woo but ended up being the main character of the story.

dramas.name: Flirting with the INTP
dramas.summary: A love story between between two university students, who study engineering and theatre, and are put into a team project.

dramas.name: First Love
dramas.summary: A music drama series that focuses on six different love stories about the innocence of teen love. Every love story is unique and powerful, packed with scenes that will give you butterflies. Feel the nervousness and the excitement as these young boys and girls fall into each other.

dramas.name: Shark: The Storm
dramas.summary: The story of Cha Woo Sol, a victim of school violence for three years, who stabbed the perpetrator in the eye, becoming a criminal from a bullying victim and a world mixed martial arts champion.

dramas.name: Dead-End Job
dramas.summary: Dead-End Job follows, a young man who takes on a seemingly perfect part-time job offering 50 times the usual hourly wage through a mysterious employment agency called Spyder Human Resource Center. However, the job quickly becomes a nightmare as he encounters strange and terrifying phenomena.

dramas.name: ONE: High School Heroes
dramas.summary: A school action drama that depicts the story of a model student who once dedicated all his attention to studying but finds himself entangled in domestic violence and school bullying, compelling him to make a transformative decision. "High School Heroes" pertains to a group formed by the main characters who stand up against school violence perpetrators on behalf of the victims.

dramas.name: A Head Coach's Turnover
dramas.summary: Maeng Gong is the coach of the professional basketball team ‘Big Pandas', which has been on the verge of elimination from the playoffs for three consecutive years. Due to poor performance, he is in danger of being fired. When he was young, he was a star player who attacked boldly on the court, as his name suggests, but now he is more famous as the ‘Young Gong Dae' coaching a professional basketball team.Ko Hwa Jin, a dedicated hater of Maeng Gong, works under the nickname ‘Maeng Gong Extermination Group'. He is a high school student who knows how to analyze the game in seconds. He is a character who has become a malicious commenter, full of hostility and a desire to get revenge on Maeng Gong.With his job on the line, Maeng Gong decides to work with his malicious commenter to achieve team results.

dramas.name: The Hunter With a Scalpel
dramas.summary: Seo Se-Hyun is a genius forensic pathologist. While examining a corpse, she discovers traces of her father Yoon Jo-Kyun who is a serial killer. She desperately attempts to track down her father Yoon Jo-Kyun with Jung Jung-Hyun. He is the chief of the violent crimes team.

dramas.name: Pro Bono
dramas.summary: The story of Kang Da Wit, a successful judge with exceptional work efficiency and quick thinking, but he is also materialistic and obsessed with success. One day, he faces an unexpected crisis and, against his will, becomes a public defender.

dramas.name: Never Fair
dramas.summary: To get a job in Seoul, Jin Woo-hyuk ended up living at the house of his mom's friend's son, On Yu, a successful writer. And that's how it all began...

dramas.name: Head Over Heels
dramas.summary: Park Seong A is a high school student, but, at night, she is a shaman named Fairy Cheon Ji. When she works as a shaman, she covers her face partially to hide her identity. She is famous as Fairy Cheon Ji and she is busy working with her clients who come to ask about their future, fortune, illnesses, and other things. One night, Bae Gyeon U and his mother come to visit Fairy Cheon Ji. Park Seong A has a crush on him at first sight, but she sees that he is destined to die soon. The next day, Bae Gyeon U appears in front of her as a new transfer student in her class. She decides to save him from his destiny.

dramas.name: Our Movie
dramas.summary: The story of a film director suffering from a Sophomore jinx and a time-limited actor who wants to live as the main character of his life only at the end of his life.

dramas.name: Salon de Holmes
dramas.summary: There is never a quiet day at Gwangseon Jugong Apartments! From noise complaints and suspicious neighbors to the petty villains who drive everyone mad, the incidents are non-stop. Fed up, four women join forces: Gong Miri, a sharp-eyed deduction specialist; Choo Kyungja, a former detective whose fists move faster than the law; Park Sohee, the ultimate neighborhood informant; and Jeon Jihyun, a former insurance sales star who knows everyone's business. As a single unit, they tackle the complex's chaos with a flawless division of labor. What begins as investigations into mundane apartment life soon spirals out of control, revealing shocking missing links. Joined by laughter and fierce loyalty, this unstoppable "womance" team is ready for action!

dramas.name: The Manipulated
dramas.summary: A blood-red revenge drama in which a man who was living normally returns from hell when his life suddenly falls into abyss one day.

dramas.name: Ball Boy Tactics
dramas.summary: After retiring from gymnastics, Han Jiwon thought his biggest challenges were behind him. Turns out, winning Olympic medals was easy compared to surviving university as a painfully shy ex-superstar. Enter Kwon Jungwoo—campus heartthrob, basketball star, and a whole new world of trouble wrapped up in a perfect smile. But just when Jiwon thinks he has Jungwoo figured out, he discovers a surprisingly sweet side beneath that cold exterior. Can this unlikely duo overcome their differences and stick the landing on their budding romance?

dramas.name: Dopamine
dramas.summary: Woo Gang, a gaming rookie, decides to follow his friends and visit a gay club for the first time. But in the club bathroom, his friends tease him by saying: "People actually do it in the bathroom here." "Can I give it a try?" Thinking it's all a joke, Woo Gang stumbles upon the unexpected. As he processes what he's seen, someone approaches him...

dramas.name: I'd Rather Quit Than Die, Director!
dramas.summary: Jinwoo Seo, who died in an accident after being sidelined at work, suddenly wakes up in the past?! He's returned to the time before his idea was stolen and decides to quit… But when Executive Director Baek Eui-hyeon says just one thing, he ends up becoming the project lead instead!

dramas.name: Ippon! : Hold Me Tight
dramas.summary: A man who dreamed of becoming a national judo representative, Jun-woo, is defeated in a single match by Min-jae, who appeared like a comet.

dramas.name: No Dating at Boarding School
dramas.summary: Set in a strict boarding school, the coming-of-age romance follows students searching for love and identity.

dramas.name: Don't Confess Next to a Corpse
dramas.summary: Late at night, Gunha and Gwangmin are left alone, bickering over an assignment, and end up dozing off. When they wake up, there's a dead body lying next to them! An assignment, a body, and a confession—how much more can they handle in one night?

dramas.name: Real Love
dramas.summary: A romance between a student and his teacher. Where will their journey take them?

dramas.name: Bon Appétit, Your Majesty
dramas.summary: What happens when a Michelin-worthy chef from Paris accidentally time-slips to the Joseon dynasty? She meets the King, a fearsome tyrant with an unexpectedly refined palate. In a bid to survive palace intrigue and royal appetites, she whips up dazzling fusion dishes that tempt even the coldest heart. But as sparks fly in the royal kitchen, a slow-burn romance simmers beneath the surface.

dramas.name: The East Palace
dramas.summary: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?

dramas.name: As You Stood By
dramas.summary: When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've carefully planned.

dramas.name: Love Phobia
dramas.summary: A VR dating CEO who hates love meets a romance-clueless writer. As they clash between AI-driven passion and analog emotions, a sweet yet messy story of healing and unexpected connection unfolds.

dramas.name: Mary Kills People
dramas.summary: Based on a Canadian series, this dark comedy is the story of a doctor who is illegally helping terminally ill patients end their life, and a detective who is investigating these illegal activities.

dramas.name: S Line
dramas.summary: Suddenly red lines appear above people's head. These red lines connect people who have had sex relations. Due to this, embarrassing or secret sides of people are revealed. People call these red lines "S Line."Han Ji-Wook (Lee Soo-Hyuk) is a detective with an attractive appearance and free spirit. He chases after the truth of the S Line. Kyu-Jin (Lee Da-Hee) is a high school teacher with unique charm. Hyun-Hob (Arin) is a high school student. She has been able to see the red lines since she was born.

dramas.name: The Defects
dramas.summary: ‘The Defects' is an action thriller depicting the desperate survival and revenge of children who barely survived on the brink of death after being abandoned by their adoptive parents.

dramas.name: Lead Male Character Search
dramas.summary: Oh Seol-Rem was the top student in her grade year at her high school. She got addicted to an online game and failed to enter a university. She is now studying to take her university entrance exam after graduating from high school. She met a male character Tarakexcali in the online game and fell in love with Tarakexcali. She never met him in real life and didn't know anything about him except that he attends Ganghan University. They even promised to marry, but one day, he suddenly disappeared from the online game. She unplugs her computer and studies hard. Finally, Oh Seol-Rem enters Ganghan University where the male character Tarakexcali is attending in real life. She looks around for Tarakexcali.

dramas.name: My Girlfriend Is the Man!
dramas.summary: Yunjae Park thought his relationship with his girlfriend, Ji-eun, was perfect--until one shocking morning changed everything. Ji-eun has mysteriously transformed into a man overnight! Can the two adjust to this sudden and earth-shattering change? And will Ji-eun ever turn back to who she once was?!

dramas.name: MY IDOL
dramas.summary: Woosang is devastated by the death of his father—and now, even the school track team is about to be disbanded. While everyone urges him to face reality, only Jaemin quietly steps closer to stand by his side.

dramas.name: Beyond the Bar
dramas.summary: A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm — navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.

dramas.name: The Winning Try
dramas.summary: Joo Ka-Ram used to be a rugby player who was the hope for Korean rugby. He had talent and star potential, but a drug scandal ruined everything. All of the sports media covered his drug scandal. He retired from the sport under the stigma of a drug addict. 3 years later, he returns as a contract coach for the high school rugby team where he once played for. The high school rugby team is the weakest team in its league. As a coach, Joo Ka-Ram shows unrivaled charisma and an uncompromising leadership ability. He also reunites with his ex-girlfriend Bae Yi-Ji (Lim Se-Mi), who is a shooting coach at the same high school. They dated for 10 years, but, after his drug scandal, Joo Ka-Ram disappeared. Now, they reunite again while working at the same high school.Meanwhile, the rugby team has 7 players including its captain Yoon Seong-Joon. Yoon Seong-Joon is in the 3rd year of high school. He has a twin brother who is a member of the junior national soccer team. Yoon Seong-Joon also played soccer in the past, but he switched to rugby due to his lack of talent. He is twisted by envy and feels inferior toward people with talent. Yet, Yoon Seong-Joon is a hard-working person who wants to be recognized in sports.

dramas.name: Love, Take Two
dramas.summary: Lee Ji Ahn has built her life on strength, dignity, and quiet resilience as a single mother. But everything shifts when her grown daughter, now a med student, stages a late rebellion-and Ji Ahn nexpectedly reconnects with her first love, Ryu Jung Suk. As mother and daughter navigate personal turning points, they discover something neither expected: the right to choose joy, love, and themselves -this time around. Not every love story happens in your twenties.

dramas.name: My Lovely Journey
dramas.summary: A full-fledged healing trip emotional drama about an idol-turned-travel reporter who has never been in the center in her life, realizing the true success and meaning of life by going on requested trips.

dramas.name: Because I Don't Want To Go Home
dramas.summary: What's wrong with going on a trip alone with a friend of the opposite sex? Yoon Seul who doesn't want to go home and Han Bit who doesn't want to go to the army begin their friendship trip! Wait no I mean, the friendship-destroying romance begins!

dramas.name: The Nameless Season
dramas.summary: Grade 12 in high school, a season between spring and summer that will never come again. It's hot and sweaty and the sound of summer bugs fills the air. Do Wan feels anxious as he senses that his time with Jae Yul is running out.

dramas.name: Confidence Man
dramas.summary: A comedy-drama that depicts three crooks extorting large sums of money from people who are stained with desire with grand and unusual plans on the stage of the colorful world of real estate and finance.

dramas.name: The Killer Next Door
dramas.summary: A bromance story between Yun Je, a timid part-timer who is afraid of guns and swords and kills people in outrageous ways, and Jin Hyeok, a former superstar baseball player who has been saving Yun Je's targets for some time.

dramas.name: Rays of Sunshine
dramas.summary: Yeon Woo grew up happy in a loving family. One day, her father had died mysteriously, and her mother remarried a man who was 10 years younger than her. Misfortunes never come singly. Her mother died of Wilson's disease and her step-father ran away with money. Min Ho, an old friend of hers, is always there to comforther. Min Ho decided to be a policeman to catch a murderer who killed Yeon Woo's father. Eun Sup came back to Korea with the sole purpose of stopping his lover Soo Ah from getting married, but Soo Ah gave him an outright denial. To make matter wose, his father sent people over to his hotel to catch him. He ran away from the hotel and he accidentally fell into the subway track and became unconscious. Yeon Woo saw the whole scene in the platform and saved his life. Eun Sup asked her if he could stay in her place temporarily since he had no place to go. So Yeon Woo, Min Ho and Eun Sup all started living in a same house.

dramas.name: My Troublesome Star
dramas.summary: A drama about a young top actress named Im Se Ra, who gets into an accident on the day she is to receive her Best Actress award, and comes back to work after a 25-year career gap.

dramas.name: Say You Love Me
dramas.summary: Say You Love Me (사랑한다 말해줘) is a poignant drama that delves into the fragile beauty of youthful love and the painful weight of adult regrets. Kim Byung-soo and Seo Young-chae have grown up together, bound by shared dreams and a quiet, enduring affection. As they step into the world of filmmaking, their bond begins to blossom into something deeper—an innocent, wholehearted romance that offers them both a sense of belonging.But their world is disrupted when they enter the orbit of Cho In-ah, a powerful and ambitious film company executive who once chose career over love. Haunted by the emotional void in her life, In-ah finds herself drawn to Byung-soo's sincerity and resents the warmth she sees between him and Young-chae. Driven by a mix of desire and jealousy, she becomes determined to fracture their love—enlisting her partner Park Hee-soo in a quiet campaign to intervene.As emotions clash and intentions blur, *Say You Love Me* becomes a layered exploration of love in its many forms—innocent, manipulative, desperate, and sacrificial. With emotionally resonant performances and a melancholic undercurrent, the drama asks whether love can truly survive ambition, insecurity, and betrayal—or whether saying "I love you" is sometimes not enough.

dramas.name: My Youth
dramas.summary: Sunwoo Hae was a popular child actor, who shined in his youth. Due to the greed of the adults around him, he lost his shining light. He barely made it through the turmoil and now lives peacefully as a novelist and florist. Suddenly, Seong Je Yeon appears in front of him. Sunwoo Hae and Seong Je Yeon were each other's first love and they helped each other get through the darkest times of their lives. They reunite after 10 years. The appearance of Je Yeon also reminds him of his past. Meanwhile, Je Yeon works as a team leader for Feel Entertainment. She grew up in a wealthy family, without any worries, but her family suddenly fell into ruin. She now lives more fiercely than anyone else around her. She is driven by reality and only looks for success in her life. To achieve her goal, she finds Sunwoo Hae, who was her first love, and breaks his peace. As she gets involved with him, she also experiences change by confronting her innocent past self.

dramas.name: Our Golden Days
dramas.summary: A story about finding the true meaning of family through the process of the older generation, and their children understanding each other's pain.

dramas.name: Dear X
dramas.summary: Behind a beautiful face hides a cruel nature—Baek Ah-jin, who sees through and manipulates others' hearts. After stepping on the sacrifices of many to reach the top, everything begins to change the moment she arrives there. A woman wearing a mask to escape hell and climb to the highest place. And the story of the Xs being brutally crushed by her.

dramas.name: First Lady
dramas.summary: A story that follows an unprecedented incident, in which a married man newly elected as president demands a divorce from his wife, who is to become the first lady. It unfolds during the 67 days leading up to the presidential inauguration, depicting the political intrigue and family secrets that emerge through the intense conflict between the president-elect and his wife.

dramas.name: Lovers
dramas.summary: Kang Jae is a wealthy businessman and gangster and Mi Joo is a plastic surgeon. These two meet after Mi Joo mistakes Kang Jae as being her sleazy brother-in-law. Kang Jae just happens to be the boyfriend of Mi Joo's pregnant neighbour, Yoo Jin. Sae Yeon meets Mi Joo and falls in love with her feisty attitude. Kang Jae works for the father of Sae Yeon who is a gangster. Mi Joo and Kang Jae fall in love.

dramas.name: Mischievous Kiss: YouTube Edition
dramas.summary: Seven short episodes dealing with Ha Ni's and Seung Jo's life after their marriage, released on the official youtube channel ytkiss.

dramas.name: Prince Barbershop
dramas.summary: Gyu-hyun and Ji-seok run the beloved Prince Barbershop. With their handsome looks and outstanding skills, they've gained quite the following. But when the adorable and charming Eun-seok shows up, a tug-of-war of love begins between the three.

dramas.name: My bias is Showing!
dramas.summary: When high school teacher Na Aejoon shows up for work on an ordinary day, he never expects to bump into his favorite celebrity in the hallway. But when his school becomes a filming location for a show starring Choi Siyeol, his bias from the idol group A-One, that's exactly what happens! If that's not enough to give a fanboy a heart attack, Siyeol takes an interest in Aejoon and asks him to join the show as his "co-teacher." Desperate to keep his fan life a secret, Aejoon is forced to put his acting skills to the test, and not just on camera. But as he spends more and more time with Siyeol, the deception becomes harder to keep up. Not to mention, he might not be the only one keeping secrets…

dramas.name: Summertime
dramas.summary: Follows Han Seun, first year Business Administration student & Yoo Chaemin, Vice President of the Basketball Club!

dramas.name: A Hundred Memories
dramas.summary: A heartbreaking first love story of a man who was destined to be the fate of two women who were bus guides in the 1980s, and a melodrama, growth, human, comedy of shining youths who were destined to be brilliant.

dramas.name: You and Everything Else
dramas.summary: From teen years to adulthood, two friends linked by warmth and tension grow apart -- until one is asked to accompany the other through her final days.

dramas.name: Siren's Kiss
dramas.summary: In Siren's Kiss, Cha Woo-seok receives a mysterious call from an informant who claims to have evidence of a fraud-related murder. Before revealing the truth, the informant falls to her death. Woo-seok's investigation leads him to Royal Auction and its chief auctioneer, Han Seol-ah, whose three fiancés have all died under suspicious circumstances. To expose the truth, or perhaps to test her, Woo-seok proposes they fake a relationship. As he uncovers her secrets, he realizes he may have stepped into a web he can't escape—and that getting out could cost him everything.

dramas.name: Ms. Incognito
dramas.summary: A comical human romance about a female bodyguard from a poor family who enters a contract marriage with a terminally ill conglomerate chairman, and has to survive under a false identity for 3 months, while guarding from those who are after her huge inheritance.

dramas.name: To the Moon
dramas.summary: A comedic survival investment story of three poor office workers who can't get by on their salaries alone, and dream of making a fortune.

dramas.name: Shin's Project
dramas.summary: Mr. Shin may look like an ordinary chicken shop owner, but he's the kind of person who appears just in time—when tempers flare, fists are about to fly, and chaos looms—to cool things down with one sharp, satisfying line that settles everything. When Philip, a by-the-book rookie judge, is suddenly reassigned to the chicken shop instead of a courtroom, and Sion, a delivery rider secretly working as Mr. Shin's informant, joins the team, the unlikely trio begins to chase the truth and seek new ground for justice. Everything seems to be running smoothly—but one question remains: Who exactly is Mr. Shin?

dramas.name: Fresh Romance
dramas.summary: Han Jung Woo is an aspiring singer-songwriter with a moist sensibility unlike his tough personality and is more serious about music than anyone else but is often hit by reality day by day for working part-time at a chicken feet restaurant. Meanwhile, Yu Chae Rin is an influencer that's considered a national goddess who lives a happy life only through social media.

dramas.name: The Story of Bihyung: Enchanted Master of the Goblin
dramas.summary: Legendary Goblins and Gumiho appear in 21st-century Seoul, Getting tangled with them, everything start to go wrong! The almighty Goblin King and the soft, squishy aspiring actor a tingling, electrifying romance fantasy begins!

dramas.name: My Secret Vampire
dramas.summary: When innocent country boy, Dongha, shows up at a mysterious vampire house, his life takes a thrilling turn.

dramas.name: A Graceful Liar
dramas.summary: After a difficult childhood with a father who was falsely accused and an absent mother, Jeong-won, now an adult, begins living as the "fake Yeong-chae" at the suggestion of her old friend Yeong-chae at a gathering of rich families. One day, Yeong-chae tries to escape to Paris to avoid an arranged marriage and asks Jeong-won to stand in for her for a month. Living as the "fake Yeong-chae," Jeong-won grows close to Se-hun, the heir to the Jinseong Group. Amidst this, Jeong-won discovers that Yeong-chae stole her designs to achieve success, and that her future mother-in-law is her biological mother. Jeong-won resolves to become the real Yeong-chae and reclaim her life.

dramas.name: No Mercy
dramas.summary: When a voice phishing scam destroys her family, struggling actress So Min dives into the underworld of deepfake technology to seek revenge. Armed with forged identities and nothing to lose, she infiltrates a powerful crime syndicate—crossing paths with a power-hungry boss, a conflicted cop, and a charmingly dangerous hacker. But as the lies stack up, the question remains: will she bring them down, or be consumed by the very deception she wields?

dramas.name: Kick in Love
dramas.summary: A once‑promising university soccer talent, Seung‑hyun, sidelined by injury, visits a futsal court for rehabilitation. Through personalized training with his dedicated therapist, Ji‑sung, and heartfelt chats on the "Kick‑in" app, both body and soul find healing—and an unexpected love blossoms on the field.

dramas.name: Typhoon Family
dramas.summary: A rookie boss inherits his father's business. An ambitious bookkeeper dreams of success. Together, they learn entrepreneurship and adulthood amid crisis.

dramas.name: Would You Marry Me?
dramas.summary: A sweet and thrilling, 90-day fake honeymoon survival romantic comedy about a man and a woman who are trying to win the ultimate newlywed prize.

dramas.name: Last Summer
dramas.summary: A work that depicts a three-dimensional romance between a woman who 'hates summer' and a man who 'waits for summer every day' as they reunite after two years. The two people who complete their romance by examining each other from the inside out will unfold against the backdrop of summer.

dramas.name: Romancing the Ghost
dramas.summary: Since childhood, Dong Min has been able to see ghosts. While searching for a new home, he encounters a breathtakingly handsome ghost—Seung Hun! "This house is mine." A ghost who refuses to leave, and a boy who can't help but fall for him.

dramas.name: TheGuyNextDoor
dramas.summary: A novelist yearning for silence and a musician haunted by loneliness clash through the wall that separates them. What begins as a deal to quiet the noise turns into nights of passion, healing, and inspiration—where only each other's presence can protect them from the darkness.

dramas.name: My Team Leader Is Working Late Again
dramas.summary: I can't stand my boss—he's the worst. But now he's under some weird ‘condition'… and the only way to break it is if I fall in love with him?!

dramas.name: It's You
dramas.summary: A story of conflict, growth, and love begins when Yeon U, still holding on to past feelings for his senior U Jin, finds out that U Jin is now engaged to his sister.

dramas.name: Connect
dramas.summary: TRUE FILM's BL web drama

dramas.name: Half of Me
dramas.summary: A car accident leaves both Taekin, a high school outcast, and Heechan, a business owner, in the hospital. But Heechan has no time to sit around and enjoy his hospital bed. If he doesn't get up and make sure his clients get their products, his business will be in jeopardy! There's just one problem. After the accident, he now inhabits the body of this high school kid every day from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Talk about an out of body experience! Heechan decides that the way to fix things is to go to Taekin's high school in the boy's body and sort things out himself! While looking for the source of their transformation, Heechan sees a familiar face from his own past. But who is going to believe this ridiculous scenario and help him out? Just how is Heechan going to get his body back?!

dramas.name: Calentos
dramas.summary: A sweet romantic love story blossoms at the perfume brand Hotel Dawson.Three guests visit Minjun, a brand employee.Minjun's heart races with excitement at their unique scents.Growing conflict, emotions, and a thrilling fragrance permeate Hotel Dawson.

dramas.name: Spirit Fingers
dramas.summary: Song U-Yeon (Park Ji-Hu) is an ordinary high school student, who isn't special in any specific thing. Her mother always put her older brother and younger brother before Song U-Yeon and her opinions are usually ignored at home. Due to this, Song U-Yeon doesn't express her feelings and she has low self-esteem.One day, a good looking man on the street asks her to pose as a model for a group of people. The man is Koo Sun-Ho (Choi Bo-Min) and the group are members of sketch club Spirit Fingers, including their President Nam Geu-Rin (Park Yoo-Na). Song U-Yeon poses on the street for them, but, unlike Song U-Yeon, the members are full of individuality and seem to get along well. This leads Song U-Yeon to join Spirit Fingers. The members encourage and compliment Song U-Yeon, which causes her self-esteem to grow.Meanwhile, Nam Gi-Jung (Jo Joon-Young) is Club President Nam Geu-Rin's younger brother and he is a high school student and the same age as Song U-Yeon. He has an attractive appearance and models for internet shopping malls as a part-time jpb. Due to Song U-Yeon, he begins to think about his future as a model seriously.

dramas.name: Peach Trap
dramas.summary: At that moment when Yoo Do Ha is in the biggest crisis of his life, three men approach him! He gets caught up in a storm of love signals with each of the three men. Even at the same time! A whirlwind of fate that centers around Do Ha. Who will the final love stick be directed towards?! A cheerful and lively romantic comedy depicting the process of finding a boyfriend.

dramas.name: Nice to Not Meet You
dramas.summary: A romantic comedy about an actor who plays the roles of detectives and wants to become a master of romcoms, and a former political reporter who has fallen from grace to entertainment journalism.

dramas.name: Love Reset
dramas.summary: TRUE FILM's second BL web drama, 'Love Reset'.

dramas.name: The Dream Life of Mr. Kim
dramas.summary: A drama that tells the story of a middle-aged man who loses everything he thought was valuable in an instant and, after a long journey, finally discovers his true self, beyond his role as a manager at a large corporation.

dramas.name: Soundtrack #2
dramas.summary: Suho and Hyunseo, who once dated for six years, meet again as a youthful rich CEO and a piano instructor. K works with Suho on a collaborative project and invites Hyeonseo to join them. Suho and Hyunseo embark on a bumpy romantic journey full of twists and turns. Will history repeat itself?

dramas.name: Marie and Her Three Daddies
dramas.summary: A drama depicting the birth of an unusual family, thicker than blood and more tenacious than sperm.

dramas.name: Idol I
dramas.summary: A romantic comedy drama and suspenseful mystery about a top star lawyer who has been a die-hard fan for 15 years, and an idol who hates his obsessive fans.

dramas.name: Dynamite Kiss
dramas.summary: A romance between a single woman who pretends to be a married mom in order to get a job, and the team leader who falls in love with her.

dramas.name: Don't Call Me Ma'am
dramas.summary: Can women in their 40s still treat themselves to a little luxury called life? Once a legendary TV home shopping host, Na Jeong is now a stay-at-home mom exhausted by the daily battles of raising two kids. When a small lie unexpectedly lands her back at her old company as an intern host, her world turns upside down. Joo Young, the perfectionist director of an art center, has always kept everything under control until her career and marriage start to crack. And Il Ri, a hopeless romantic and magazine editor, struggles to choose between her ideals and reality. As three friends laugh, cry, and stumble their way through midlife crisis, they rediscover who they are and what truly matters. Perfect or not, their second act might be their best one yet.

dramas.name: Grand Galaxy Hotel
dramas.summary: Only open in the middle of the night to provide top-class service and console the souls of the dead, the Grand Galaxy Hotel has a new owner, Eun-ha. Upon his arrival, he meets the human hotel manager Sang-soon, who does not fear ghosts.

dramas.name: If Wishes Could Kill
dramas.summary: The fears and dreams of teenagers caught between ambition and reality. Using the app is simple: upload a video of your wish and wait for it to come true — at a cost. What shocking truths will they uncover as they grapple with the consequences of their wishes?

dramas.name: Armored Saurus
dramas.summary: The story of dinosaurs equipped with state-of-the-art suits and their pilots fighting against alien mechanical dinosaur corps.

dramas.name: Heroes Next Door
dramas.summary: It tells the thrilling and humorous story of a reserve special forces unit that comes together not to protect the country or promote world peace but solely to safeguard their families and neighborhood.

dramas.name: Never Forget Your Enemy
dramas.summary: After a car accident, Gi Ha Neul wakes up at age 29 with only the memories of his 19-year-old self, losing an entire decade of his life. The biggest shock comes when he learns that during those missing years, he was in a seven-year relationship with his lifelong rival, Yeo Sae Byeok. While photos, messages, and even his own instincts suggest they were deeply in love, Ha Neul remembers him only as the enemy who overshadowed him throughout childhood. As fragments of memory slowly return, he begins to suspect that their relationship ended for a reason and that Sae Byeok may be hiding the truth.

dramas.name: The 4th Love Revolution
dramas.summary: A youth romance that takes place when the Department of Computer Engineering and the Department of Modeling are merged.

dramas.name: Surely Tomorrow
dramas.summary: In their twenties, Lee Kyeong-do and Seo Ji-woo part ways after two passionate relationships. A decade later, they meet again as a reporter who covers an adultery scandal and the wife of the man at the center of that scandal. Reuniting in their late thirties, their youth has passed, but their love remains vivid. Kyungdo now strives to prove to her and to himself that he still loves her.

dramas.name: The Judge Returns
dramas.summary: Based on a web novel, this courtroom time-slip drama tells the story of an upright judge named Lee Han Yeong, who dies after being falsely accused, and ends up 20 years in the past.

dramas.name: Portraits of Delusion
dramas.summary: Set in Gyeongseong in 1935, the series follows painter Yun Il Ho, who is tasked with creating a portrait of Song Jeong Hwa—a mysterious woman who has remained out of public view for more than half a century and is the subject of countless rumors. As he steps into her world, a web of secrets begins to unravel, pulling him deeper into a suspense-laced narrative.

dramas.name: Tide of Love
dramas.summary: Han Jae-hoon is a wealthy heir who hides his pain behind cold indifference while Kim Hae-jun, a bright art student is burdened by life's weight. What begins as a transactional relationship gradually transforms into a tender bond. In their shared solitude and unspoken care, they slowly draw closer, yet the thing that binds them keeps them from confronting their true feelings. As the tide rises and secrets surface, they must decide: will they remain confined by the rules, or will they dare to love?

dramas.name: Thundercloud Rainstorm
dramas.summary: At his uncle's funeral, Jeonghan is reunited with Iljo, a man he hasn't seen in years. It turns out Iljo's struggling to stay afloat. Stirred by pity and charitable impulse, Jeonghan invites Iljo to move in with him. The problem is that Iljo catches feelings like a match to fuel. To top it off, Jeonghan isn't keen on dating him, but somehow, he's a pro at accidentally making things a lot messier for everyone involved. Is this a love story in the making, or a disaster waiting to happen?

dramas.name: Kiss Kiss Sxx
dramas.summary: Each work differs in tone, style and relationships, but the eight stories, each with a completely different worldview, will be completed as a single omnibus drama.

dramas.name: No Tail to Tell
dramas.summary: Imbued with the power to grant wishes, a cynical nine-tailed fox's life takes a turn when she encounters a football player -- altering both of their fates.

dramas.name: Spring Fever
