dramas.summary: Spring Fever: the tiredness people often feel in spring. Yun Bom, a teacher with a frozen heart, arrives at a small rural school and slowly rediscovers joy through Seon Jae Gyu's warmth.

dramas.name: Villains
dramas.summary: A bloody confrontation takes place between villains over super-notes, which is a counterfeit bill of extreme high quality.

dramas.name: Bird That Doesn't Cry
dramas.summary: A Bird That Doesn't Cry is a melodrama centered on Oh Ha-nui, a woman whose life collapses after she becomes entangled in a high-stakes insurance murder case. What begins as a sudden family tragedy grows into a destructive chain of lies, greed, and betrayal.As Ha-nui loses the stability and relationships she once relied on, she discovers that a woman named Chun Mi-ja stands at the heart of the events that ruined her life. Determined not to remain a victim, Ha-nui sets out to uncover the truth behind the crime and confront the people who exploited her pain for their own gain.The story follows her journey through revenge, complicated loyalties, and the emotional cost of pursuing justice in a world where everyone has something to hide.

dramas.name: Undercover Miss Hong
dramas.summary: Set against the backdrop of the 1990s, this retro office comedy follows Hong Geum Bo, a no-nonsense financial regulator in her 30s who lives for her work. But when suspicious activity surfaces at a major securities firm, her career takes an unexpected turn. Tasked with uncovering the truth, Geum Bo goes undercover as a 20-year-old high school graduate, diving headfirst into an unfamiliar world of office politics, outdated tech, and hilarious culture clashes.

dramas.name: Love Me
dramas.summary: A drama that portrays the story of a family that is a little selfish and perhaps more ordinary than their own, who cherished each other's lives as they grew to love each other.

dramas.name: To My Beloved Thief
dramas.summary: Eun-jo is the true identity behind Gil-dong, the legendary righteous bandit who robs corrupt officials and redistributes their wealth to the people. Born as the illegitimate daughter of Minister Hong and raised in the lowest social class, Eun-jo lives in a Joseon society where no one would ever suspect a woman of being a notorious outlaw. Behind this prejudice, she carefully maintains a flawless double life. Meanwhile, Yi Yeol—the prince assigned to capture Gil-dong—falls in love with Eun-jo at first sight and begins to pursue her, completely unaware that the woman he loves is the very thief he is hunting.This is a sweeping and dangerous romance: a woman who unintentionally becomes Joseon's greatest thief and a prince bound by duty find their fates intertwined. When their souls are mysteriously exchanged, they embark on a journey to save each other—and ultimately, to protect the people.

dramas.name: Dream to You
dramas.summary: A romantic comedy exploring the lives of two individuals at different crossroads in life. Reporter Lee Jae has transitioned from a fearless teen driven by dreams to a disillusioned 20-something facing the harsh realities of life, and finally becoming an adult in her 30s who feels like she has settled into mediocrity. On the other hand, film director Su Bin has lived a life designed by his parents during his teenage years but eventually broke free and charged through his 20s and ultimately achieved the dream he had longed for by his 30s.

dramas.name: The First Man
dramas.summary: A drama depicting a life-threatening confrontation between a woman who takes another person's life for revenge and a woman who takes another person's life for her own desires.

dramas.name: Phantom Lawyer
dramas.summary: While Shin Yi Rang dreams of joining a prestigious law firm, he's constantly rejected due to his father's criminal past. Undeterred, he "borrows" money from his mother and opens up his own law firm in a building formerly owned by a shaman. His life and career take a supernatural turn after incense he found in a desk drawer gifts him with the ability to communicate with – and be possessed by – ghosts. With unexpected help from elite lawyer Han Na Hyun, Yi Rang is able to get justice for his first ghostly client, although she's reluctant to admit that spirits are truly speaking to Yi Rang. As their peculiar partnership continues to develop, Yi Rang and Na Hyun find themselves growing closer in more ways than one, all while helping lingering spirits get the closure they need to pass on.

dramas.name: Solo Leveling
dramas.summary: An E-rank Hunter gains extraordinary abilities after a near-death experience and becomes humanity's unexpected hope against monstrous threats.

dramas.name: Positively Yours
dramas.summary: The story of Jang Hui Won, a successful woman who prioritizes her career over marriage. She works late-night shifts and weekends, but one night, her life takes an unexpected turn when she impulsively becomes pregnant with the company's president and insists on marriage.

dramas.name: Scarecrow
dramas.summary: Criminal profiler Kang Tae Joo is pulled out of retirement by a chilling summons: an imprisoned serial killer has been linked to additional unsolved deaths through DNA evidence, but he insists that Tae Joo joins the investigation, believing that Tae Joo can prove his innocence. Tae Joo is brought back into a world he thought he'd left behind 33 years earlier, forcing him to face ambitious prosecutor Cha Si Young, with whom he shares a difficult past, in pursuit of the truth. But as with many cold cases, the truth isn't as straightforward as it seems – and Tae Joo might be more involved than even he knows. Can Tae Joo finally close the chapter on the "Scarecrow" murders for good, or will a new twist upend his life?

dramas.name: I Kill U
dramas.summary: The story unfolds as a part-timer who was once a promising Taekwondo player, but now has a resemblance to the biological granddaughter of Beomhan Construction, who was accused of being the main culprit in a hit-and-run while drunk, and takes on the role of appearing in the media on her behalf.

dramas.name: Boyfriend on Demand
dramas.summary: Seo Mi-rae is worn out by work. Love? It's the last thing on her mind. But a virtual dating service sparks feelings - and maybe a real shot at romance.

dramas.name: Bloody Flower
dramas.summary: A serial killer who has the ability to cure all incurable diseases, posing a shocking question that overturns law and common sense and building viewers' anticipation.

dramas.name: Recipe for Love
dramas.summary: Both family members of Western and Traditional Korean medicine hospitals in Onjeong City have had bad blood towards each other for 30 years due to a misunderstanding. Ju-ah and Hyun-bin, each hailing from rival medical families, spend a drunken night together. They later find themselves reunited in the workplace as boss and employee.Even Ju-ah, who is repulsed by the idea of marriage, eventually falls for Hyun-bin, the guy who liked her and who becomes to the ‘straightforward young man', but their relationship turns things upside down for the families. Eventually, the truth of the ‘runaway incident' from 30 years ago is revealed and the two families barely go into reconciliation mode, and it looked like the grudge might end… but a new crisis awaits them.

dramas.name: Sword & Silence
dramas.summary: A large-scale historical drama that highlights the great victory of the small nation of Silla, which defeated Goguryeo, Baekje, and even the Tang Dynasty, and completed the unification of the three kingdoms.

dramas.name: Honour
dramas.summary: Ra Young, Shin Jae, and Hyun Jin are lawyers at LnJ, a law firm for women who are victims of sexual abuse. Their relationship is well-defined, starting with Shin Jae's leadership as CEO of the firm. Ra Young serves as a messenger, regarded as a celebrity lawyer with outstanding eloquence, while Hyun Jin always rushes to the scene to find out evidence. They start to investigate a sexual abuse case involving underage students, and they confront the challenging situation head-on against the cartel of sexual abuse on digital platforms. As they approach the truth of the case, their lives begin to fall into danger, while their past memories haunt them repeatedly. Will they be able to save the victims and overcome the bruises from their past? It is the perfect time to retrieve their lost honour.

dramas.name: Our Universe
dramas.summary: A pair of in-laws, whose constant quarrels have turned affection into animosity, suddenly find themselves responsible for raising their 20-month-old nephew after the unexpected accident of his parents. What follows is a chaotic yet heartwarming romance under one roof.

dramas.name: Agent Kim Reactivated
dramas.summary: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.

dramas.name: The Art of Sarah
dramas.summary: A supposed luxury maven. A detective with a keen eye. As he digs into her shifting story, the truth behind a murder case slowly comes to light.

dramas.name: Love In Protocol
dramas.summary: Jeong Yeon joins the research lab of Yu Geon, his former private tutor, as an intern. However, Yu Geon's attitude upon their reunion is cold. An experiment that studies emotions, and two people facing each other once again. Subtle waves begin to ripple between Jeong Yeon and Yu Geon.

dramas.name: The Blue Road
dramas.summary: Bizarre murders discovered in two countries unite police as the brutal truth emerges.

dramas.name: Match Play re-edited ver.
dramas.summary: A quiet, steadfast stuntman Jaeyeon strictly follows his principles. He's assigned to train Doha, an idol cast in an action movie. But Doha is unruly, proud, and refuses to listen. Still, Jaeyeon is just as stubborn. He puts a stop to Doha's tricks and shortcuts without mercy, and the two inevitably become bitter rivals. Then one day, their usual bickering is captured in an idol behind-the-scenes video, and Jaeyeon suddenly gains unexpected popularity… marking the beginning of a situation neither of them saw coming.

dramas.name: Take Charge of My Heart
dramas.summary: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

dramas.name: The Remarried Empress
dramas.summary: Beloved Empress Navier of the Eastern Empire has built and led a prosperous land alongside her husband, Emperor Sovieshu. One day her world is shattered when the emperor brings Rashta, a runaway slave, back to the palace with the intention of making her his mistress. But even as the threat of a broken future looms over her, Navier refuses to let her emotions sway her, and when Prince Heinrey, a rival leader of the Western Kingdom, shows interest in her, Navier will make a life-changing decision to rewrite her destiny.

dramas.name: Still Shining
dramas.summary: After falling in love as teens, two young adults drift apart — only to reunite 10 years later and confront their heartbreak, growth and new challenges.

dramas.name: Will You Be My Manager
dramas.summary: Japanese high schooler Hirose Hana dreams of becoming a manager for top pop groups. She transfers to Segi Art High School, a South Korean school that has produced some of the Korean entertainment industry's brightest stars. Her first few days are a success, and she soon strikes up a friendship with the handsome and popular aspiring singer Koo Eun Ho. But she soon discovers that egos at the school are fragile, and that her own success may be stoking resentment in others. Worse still, someone at the school has learned that she is harboring a secret – and threatens to make it public. Is disaster in the cards for her, or will her new friends help her fulfill her dreams at this highly competitive school?

dramas.name: The Practical Guide to Love
dramas.summary: Blind dates seem like the most efficient way to meet someone. So Ui-yeong, still single despite yearning for love, decides to seek romance through blind dates. After a few attempts, two very different men step into her life—Tae-seop, quietly attentive, and Ji-su, playful and refreshing—leading her on an unexpected journey toward understanding what love truly means.

dramas.name: 100 Days of Deception
dramas.summary: With their fates at stake, 100 days of deception begin. In 1930s Gyeongseong, "Lee Ga-gyeong," the city's most skilled pickpocket, strikes a deal with Korean independence fighters and infiltrates the Government-General of Joseon under a false identity, hoping to start a new life in America. There, she meets "Sato Hideo," an elite interpreter working for the Government-General of Joseon, and the two gradually grow closer despite concealing their respective motives and secrets. As an intelligence battle unfolds between the independence fighters and the Government-General, the two begin to see each other for who they truly are, and their 100-day mission sets off a series of events that upend both their lives.

dramas.name: Laundry Romance
dramas.summary: Life, like clothes, sometimes gets wrinkled and shriveled. Jae Min, a 30-year-old job seeker who lives with anxiety that clings to him like grime, and Ji Seok, a 34-year-old voluntary unemployed person who threw away his well-ironed shirt and chose to stop. A healing romance between two men that blends in with the noise of the washing machines running late at night at a coin laundromat.

dramas.name: Always Meet Again
dramas.summary: Everyone has imagined it at least once. What if you could go back to the past? Jang Hye Seong, a well-known painter, visits his alma mater, Seongjin High School, to give a special lecture at the request of his friend Tae Jun. During a break, he stops by the art room and discovers his old sketchbook. Inside it, he finds a drawing of his first love, Lee U Jin, half undressed. On impulse, Hye Seong redraws U Jin right there. The moment he finishes the painting and puts the brush down, he is suddenly transported back to 2008, his high school days, where he reunites with U Jin. Even after returning, Hye Seong doesn't want to repeat the mistakes he made back then, so he tries to keep his distance from U Jin. But with U Jin boldly and persistently coming closer, Hye Seong is left completely defenseless. Their eighteen begins again. Can they change their fate and finally reach each other?

dramas.name: ONnOFF
dramas.summary: These intense gazes, this tension... you're really telling me there's nothing between them? The subtle undercurrent flowing between them creates breathtaking suspense! Colleagues? Rivals? Lovers? The boundaries are becoming blurred.

dramas.name: Mad Concrete Dreams
dramas.summary: In Korea, nothing defines success more than owning a building. Ki Su-jong, once an ordinary office worker, believes that going all in—risking everything and drowning in debt—to finally become a landlord will be his way out. But when global capital swoops in and threatens to push his building into foreclosure, Su-jong clings to a desperate plan with his best friend: a staged kidnapping in the building's basement that spirals into a real one. Trapped in a chain of crimes that could destroy his life or save it, Su-jong is forced to make impossible choices. How far will he go to keep his dream from collapsing?

dramas.name: Concrete Market
dramas.summary: After the Great Earthquake, the world is razed to the ground. In the lone apartment complex left standing, survivors have established the Hwang Gung Market, where cash is dead and canned food is the new currency. Everything, from fuel to intelligence, is traded here. Park Sang-yong, the President of the Merchants, rules the market with an iron fist, forcing people to find their own ways to survive under his absolute order. But the status quo is shattered when a mysterious girl, He-ro, sneaks in to steal canned food. After discovering Sang-yong's fatal secret, she proposes a treacherous deal to his right-hand man, Tae-jin. As the Market's solid order begins to crack, alliance and betrayal become mere choices for survival. Who will endure to emerge as the master of the Market?

dramas.name: Climax
dramas.summary: In a desperate attempt to revitalize his stagnant career, prosecutor Bang Tae Seop hatches an absurd but daring plan: take down the mayor of Seoul by exposing her corrupt ties to Lee Yang Mi, the head of the WR Group conglomerate. Tae Seop recruits Hwang Jeong Won to serve as an informant and manages to convince Kwon Jong Uk, a WR Group heir with his own grudge against Yang Mi, to join his cause. However, Tae Seop soon finds himself in a more complicated situation than he initially expected when he discovers that his wife Chu Sang Ah, a formerly loved actress, may be hiding dangerous secrets from him.

dramas.name: Doctor Shin
dramas.summary: Top actress Momo is preparing to marry Ju Shin, the accomplished director of a neurosurgery hospital who seems to have everything. But a sudden accident leaves her body intact while her brain is fatally damaged, plunging her into a coma. Faced with the devastating possibility of losing the woman he loves, genius neurosurgeon Ju Shin makes a desperate decision and ventures into forbidden medical territory. In a final attempt to save her, he performs an unprecedented "brain change" surgery, transferring another soul into Momo's body. When she opens her eyes again, the soul within her is no longer the woman he once loved. If another soul inhabits the body of the person you love, can that love remain the same? A forbidden choice made to save love unfolds into an unforeseen fate and devastating consequences.

dramas.name: Cabbage Your Life
dramas.summary: Seong Tae Hun, a high-ranking executive, is suddenly reassigned to the rural village of Yeonri-ri with his family. Unprepared for country life, Cho Mi Ryeo struggles as farming and housework prove harder than expected. Meanwhile, their eldest son, Seong Ji Cheon, once bound for medical school, begins to discover himself. However, village chief Im Ju Hyeong grows wary of the family, who arrived with a major corporation. As they endure rural life while longing to return, can they find their way back?

dramas.name: Filing for Love
dramas.summary: Ki-jun, once the ace of the internal audit team, is now stuck handling petty office scandals—all thanks to his manager, In-ah. One day, he receives an anonymous tip: In-ah is involved in an inappropriate relationship at work. Digging into her secret for revenge, Ki-jun instead finds himself drawn to her.

dramas.name: We Are All Trying Here
dramas.summary: An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.

dramas.name: My Royal Nemesis
dramas.summary: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.

dramas.name: Sold Out on You
dramas.summary: A workaholic home shopping host heads to the countryside to get her sales back on top, but a mysterious farmer shakes up her plans — and her heart

dramas.name: Gold Land
dramas.summary: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring's gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

dramas.name: The Koreans
dramas.summary: Set during the wave of democratization and cultural modernization that swept across South Korea in the early 1990s, The Koreans will follow a middle-class family hiding a treasonous secret. While seemingly ordinary citizens in the eyes of their friends, neighbors and even their children, both parents actually are elite North Korean spies working to bring down the South from within. Highlighting the stark difference between these two formerly united countries, the series will follow the spies as they wrestle with conflicting feelings of patriotism, loyalty, identity and love, while a ruthless Korean counterintelligence agent draws ever closer to discovering their identities.

dramas.name: The Scandal
dramas.summary: In Joseon's world of rank and reputation, an aristocratic wife and an infamous libertine pull a reserved lady into a scheme where love turns dangerous.

dramas.name: Pearl in Red
dramas.summary: Pearl in Red tells the story of Kim Dan-hee and Baek Jin-ju, who both seek revenge against the Adel Group by infiltrating the company under false identities after losing a beloved family member.

dramas.name: Our Sticky Love
dramas.summary: Amnesia, small-town hijinks and a shadowy past — classic tropes collide in this rom-com about a star prosecutor and the boxing coach who upends her life.

dramas.name: The Husband
dramas.summary: Kang Tae Ju, a former neurosurgeon who now serves as a hospital director engages in an extreme fight with a criminal with a human face to save his wife who was kidnapped right before divorce.

dramas.name: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier
dramas.summary: In the game of life, we all face countless quests of choice. Kang Sung-jae, who enlisted to escape a harsh reality, one day encounters a mysterious virtual "Quest" screen to become an army cook. With each quest he clears, hidden secrets of the base, even those tied to his father's death, begin to surface.

dramas.name: Absolute Value of Romance
dramas.summary: A quiet student by day, a romance novelist by night, Eui-ju is inspired when four gorgeous teachers appear: icy Woo-su, lively Da-ju, gruff Gi-jeon, and gentle Dong-ju. She writes them into her new novel, which blows up overnight! But her secret is discovered by Woo-su, her worst enemy since day one. She accepts his deal to protect her secret, but can she finish this novel unscathed?

dramas.name: Scandal love
dramas.summary: In the highly commercialized idol industry, emotions are often manufactured and sold as part of the brand. Scandal Love follows four women navigating different levels of power within a K-pop girl group system. As they struggle with strict contracts, overwhelming public scrutiny, and their own genuine feelings, each is forced to make impossible choices. The series explores one central question: can real love survive inside relationships that are carefully designed and controlled?

dramas.name: Sweet Blood
dramas.summary: On the night of a blue moon lunar eclipse that happens once in ten years, the portal between the vampire world, where drinking human blood is forbidden, and the human world opens. Lucifer, a vampire prince who desperately craves human blood, descends into the human world. Min U, a university student in his early twenties, moves to the city from the countryside. He works tirelessly, day and night, to save up for tuition while also studying hard. However, Min U contracts a rare disease that puts his life at risk whenever he bleeds. One day, Min U becomes a victim of a hit-and-run accident, bleeding and finding himself in a life-threatening situation. Lucifer, drawn by the scent of blood, attacks Min U. However, something strange happens: Lucifer collapses, and Min U miraculously survives, unharmed.

dramas.name: Doctor X: Mafia in White
dramas.summary: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

dramas.name: Azure Spring
dramas.summary: After years marked by injury and failure, former swimmer Anna returns to her quiet seaside hometown, leaving her dreams behind. There, she crosses paths with Yun Deok Hyun, a quiet sea diver who remains trapped in his past, enduring time in silence. Brought together under one roof, Anna begins to learn diving from him, slowly finding her way back to life. But as their distance closes, unspoken emotions rise, and a long buried secret surrounding Deok Hyun begins to fracture their fragile peace. As the past refuses to stay buried, both are pushed to confront what they have been running from and find the courage to move forward.

dramas.name: Fifties Professionals
dramas.summary: Three seemingly ordinary middle-aged men—behind their modest looks are the pro skills that made them legends in their fields. Now in their fifties, thinking their glory days are long gone, they are unexpectedly pulled back into action. Even if your life hasn't been perfect so far, it's about filling the rest of your 50%—no matter what age you are. Just like these pros in their fifties.

dramas.name: Final Table
dramas.summary: Follows Choi Song I, the new manager of a family restaurant, who must step up to take charge after her father's sudden death. In a bid to save the restaurant, she becomes entangled in a fierce cooking competition alongside Kang Han, also known as "Chris K", a renowned overseas chef. Their journey brings them head-to-head with Cha U Jin, a perfectionist chef and Kang Han's fiercest rival, whose relentless ambition drives the intense rivalry. At the center of the competition is Seon Jeong Won, the executive producer of The Table: K Chef 2026, who orchestrates the high-stakes event to crown Korea's top chef. As the chefs compete, their personal stories and ambitions unfold, creating a dynamic and dramatic showdown of culinary mastery.

dramas.name: The Facade of Love
dramas.summary: Ji-hun and Hu-kyung, two strangers far from home, spend an unforgettable night together in an unfamiliar place. Both know that once they return to Korea, life is supposed to go back to normal. But the connection they share follows them home and small cracks begin to appear, slowly upending the lives of four people. As their relationships knot together, The Facade of Love peels back what lies beneath the polished surfaces of their lives: desire, guilt, hurt and the gap between the stories we tell ourselves and the truths we can't escape.

dramas.name: Human x Gumiho
dramas.summary: A top actress who is secretly a 2,000-year-old gumiho with the power to bewitch humans becomes romantically entangled with a man who is uniquely immune to her enchantments, forcing them to navigate a romance where their supernatural powers collide.

dramas.name: A Love Other Than Yours
dramas.summary: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

dramas.name: Sacred Jewel
dramas.summary: In 1258, amid thirty years of relentless Mongol invasions, the Emperor commands elite warriors to retrieve the Sacred Jewel, a divine relic protecting the kingdom. The warriors break through Mongolian lines and journey toward the eastern sea in search of the legendary relic.

dramas.name: See You At Work Tomorrow!
dramas.summary: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

dramas.name: Nine to Six
dramas.summary: Kang Yi Ji has long kept romance on the sidelines, pouring all her energy into her career. Her perspective shifts when she meets Han Seon Woo, whose warmth and thoughtfulness help her rediscover love. Together, they navigate both professional challenges and personal growth, finding balance in work and life.

dramas.name: Reborn Rookie
dramas.summary: Kang Yong Ho is the chairman of the Choiseong Group, a leading conglomerate in South Korea. He built the company by himself, and he is now known as the "God of Business". One day, he has an unexpected accident. He collides with a young man named Hwang Jun Hyeon. Hwang Jun Hyeon is a soccer player who has just joined the League 1 team FC Choiseong. Due to the accident, Chairman Kang Yong Ho's soul is swapped with soccer player Hwang Jun Hyeon's soul. With Chairman Kang Yong Ho's soul in Hwang Jun Hyeon's body, he applies to the Choiseong Group as a new employee. He begins his unpredictable journey with his soul as an outstanding businessman and the young body of Hwang Jun Hyeon.

dramas.name: Doctor on the Edge
dramas.summary: Elite plastic surgeon Do Jiui has his perfect life turned upside down when he's unexpectedly sent to the remote island of Pyeondongdo as a public health doctor. Surrounded by the sea, the island is more than just isolation for him, as past trauma has turned the ocean into an unknowable terror and a massive prison. Intrusive locals and grotesque bugs turn life into a living hell for the city man. Amid it all, a mysterious nurse, Yuk Hari, appears. Hiding secrets behind her gentle smile, she always seems to be nearby when Jiui is overwhelmed by his fear of the sea. As the two become entangled on the small island, can Jiui overcome his past and escape safely?

dramas.name: Painter it the night
dramas.summary: A young artist who creates homoerotic scenes finds himself entangled in a complicated relationship with a nobleman who has an obsessive interest in both his artwork and himself

dramas.name: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
dramas.summary: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

dramas.name: Check in to You
dramas.summary: Two men who are so different! An unpredictable drama that started when his soul was changed by an accident

dramas.name: The Apartment Job
dramas.summary: A once-feared gangster enters the race for apartment association president, driven by greed for hidden funds. But his quest for easy money unravels a web of corruption—and against all odds, he emerges as the unlikely champion of the residents.

dramas.name: Spooky in Love
dramas.summary: When a ghost-seeing heiress and an ace prosecutor discover that a single touch makes them an unlikely crime-solving duo, they team up to uncover unsolved murders. Cheon Yeo-ri, a hotel CEO haunted by spirits of people who died unjustly, joins forces with prosecutor Ma Kang-wook to investigate paranormal cases. As they unravel mysteries together, their strange partnership soon turns into something more romantic.

dramas.name: Winter Fever
dramas.summary: After fifteen years of friendship turned love, Seo Yu Jun breaks up with Kang Yeon Ho, convinced his devotion is pity and believing Yeon Ho would be better off without him. The rejection shatters Yeon Ho, whose love turns into obsession as he prioritizes keeping Yu Jun close at any cost. Meanwhile, Baek Hyeon Seo, a seemingly kind senior, manipulates their pain for his own benefit, pulling the three into a tragic love triangle driven by guilt, obsession, and control.

dramas.name: The Lie We Lived In
dramas.summary: A contract killer, Seo I Do, arrives at a secluded house to take out his target, Heo Dong Hwa. Before he can finish the job, his boss unexpectedly orders him to stay put and to keep Dong Hwa captive instead. Things get messy fast when a cheerful stranger, Chu Tae Jeong, suddenly shows up. He's an old friend of Dong Hwa and was already promised a week-long stay. Their first meeting crackles with tension, and in the chaos, Tae Jeong mistakes I Do for Dong Hwa's younger brother, who supposedly left for the US years ago. I Do rides that misunderstanding, acting like the brother while quietly plotting to get Tae Jeong out of the way. His plan takes a sharp turn when he discovers Tae Jeong is actually a detective.

dramas.name: Between Steps
dramas.summary: Depicts the romance between a man who once was a swimmer but lost his left leg to illness and a woman who, after losing her way as a medical resident, finds a new path as a graduate student. Park Min Jae, a man who lost his promising swimming career and his left leg to osteosarcoma. After hitting rock bottom, he discovers a new purpose in robotics. Four years of dedication pay off when he is accepted into the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Seoul National University. He hides his sensitivity behind a nonchalant facade, but he's actually just a simple guy who has dating on his bucket list. Im Yu Jin, who is on the verge of graduating from the Department of Clothing and Textiles when she gets caught up in an incident and fails in her attempt to enter graduate school; she then becomes fascinated by robotics and enrolls in a master's program in mechanical engineering.

dramas.name: Notes from the Last Row
dramas.summary: A failed writer-turned-professor finds rare talent in a student's writing — and grows obsessed with his draft as their private lessons go off course.

dramas.name: Wind Up
dramas.summary: A sports fantasy growth drama based on baseball, that tells the story of a high school baseball player and an unknown transfer student

dramas.name: Adieu Solo
dramas.summary: It is a fake reality drama set against the backdrop of a luxury resort in Pattaya, Thailand, where eight young men and women engage in a love survival game that blurs the lines between sincerity and pretense, ideals and reality.

dramas.name: Fix the Error!
dramas.summary: Ji Han, the grim reaper who manages death, receives a list of names and descends to the human world again today. School, unfamiliar scenery, and a strange self. But the task seemed simple: he simply needed to find the target of the code floating above his head. But the code written on the register hovered over two people simultaneously. One was Hyeon Jun, with his indifferent gaze, the other Yung Hui, with his playful smile. The question, "Who should die?" soon morphed into "Who should live?" and Ji Han, hiding his identity, began living as a student alongside the two.

dramas.name: Love in Sync
dramas.summary: An emotional transference romance that unfolds as a woman who denies empathy and a man who bears the burden of empathy come to share each other's emotions. Cha Eun Hwan, a man who bears others' emotions excessively. He is a psychological counseling expert who has gained widespread popularity for his unique counseling methods. However, after becoming entangled in an unexpected incident, his everyday life and emotional balance begin to unravel. As he falls into despair, a figure connected to his past appears, bringing changes to both his life and his emotions. Yoo Ji An, a former girl group member who was once called the "Nation's Idol" and enjoyed explosive popularity, is now working as an actress. Having lived her life suppressing her emotions under her mother's strict control since childhood, Ji An faces a crisis due to controversy over her acting skills, stemming from her lack of empathy. She then meets Cha Eun Hwan, a psychological counseling expert, and unexpectedly experiences "emotional transference." Through this experience, she begins to rediscover her lost emotions and grow as a person.

dramas.name: The Prosecutor's Office's Proposal
dramas.summary: From the director of ‘Secret Relationships', follows the romance between an investigator burdened by the stigma of "being a murderer's son" and a prosecutor.

dramas.name: Whale Star: The Gyeongseong Mermaid
dramas.summary: Set in 1926 Gyeongseong during Japanese occupation that follows the story of Kang Ui Hyeon, a man who dedicates everything to his country, and Su A, a woman who risks her life to protect him. A Korean reimaging of Hans Christian Andersen's "The Little Mermaid."

dramas.name: Sin and Love
dramas.summary: Police, drug lords, undercover agents, and spies—all layers of the power system are collapsing. Behind a seemingly lawful police hierarchy lies a city controlled by corruption, desire, and hidden power games, where human lives are only bargaining chips. A mysterious kidnapping exposes a buried network of crimes, unraveling misaligned identities, systemic corruption, and a long-suppressed past. Love and sex become tools of control and exchange. And the real chaos began ten years ago, within a forgotten relationship that never truly ended.

dramas.name: My Bias, My Boss
dramas.summary: For thirteen years, Nam Da Reum has been a dedicated fan of idol star Lee Chan. When she lands a job at fashion company APPELLO, she's shocked to find out that her beloved idol co-founded the company. Da Reum resolves to hide her identity as a fan and prove that she can be a professional. However, when she starts work, she's faced instead with workaholic CEO Kang Ha Gi, Chan's childhood friend. Meanwhile, Ha Gi seems to harbor hidden, unrequited feelings for Chan, and Chan struggles to maintain his public persona while dealing with a complicated personal life. As the three become entangled, Da Reum finds herself caught between her past obsession with Chan and a growing, unexpected connection with Ha Gi. .

dramas.name: Mousetrap
dramas.summary: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

dramas.name: A Bona Fide Killer
dramas.summary: Ordinary working mom Yu Bo Na is secretly the legendary assassin Kingfisher, who eliminates criminals beyond the reach of the law. Returning to work after three years of maternity leave, she resumes a perilous double life, balancing work, childcare, housework, and assassinations. As her missions grow more dangerous, a detective hunting a mysterious killer and a husband beginning to suspect the truth threaten to expose her secret. From school drop-offs to taking down criminals, every moment is a high-wire act with no room to slip up. The instant her true identity surfaces, she stands to lose everything. Can Yu Bo Na keep her identity hidden and protect both worlds as a loving wife and mother to her family and a ruthless killer to her targets?

dramas.name: Quiet in the Office!
dramas.summary: Nayul was at her breaking point. Between the crushing workload and her detestable boss, Kwon Sijin-a man who perfected the art of trampling on dignity-she'd had enough. At 11 PM on a Friday, driven by pure rage, she stormed into his office. There, time froze. Nayul stood paralyzed, having caught her "perfect" yet perverted boss in the middle of a private, lewd act during overtime.

dramas.name: Romantic Island
dramas.summary: Ye Ji enters a 19+ dating show with a huge cash prize for her boyfriend, who lost everything. The only way to win the 1.9 billion prize is to spend the night with another man. There, she meets Jae Hyeon, her first love, and Do Hyeok, the ex-husband she broke up with after an affair. Between true love, the 1.9 billion prize, and her own desires—what will Ye Ji choose?

dramas.name: Virgin Love Hell
dramas.summary: After joining a dating survival show, "Hot Dating Zone," at Su-a's request, Solji is assigned overwhelming physical-affection missions and gets entangled in relationships with three different guys, which turns out to be set up by Su-a to humiliate her. Now, Solji has to find a way to escape from this chaos full of betrayal and excitement.

dramas.name: Love on the Menu
dramas.summary: Some sacrificed love for the sake of family. Others walked away from their families to protect the ones they loved. And some, believing they were acting out of love, only left deeper wounds behind. Years of misunderstanding and conflict have driven them apart, but an unexpected bond and reunion bring them face-to-face once again. As lost love, tangled family ties, and the true feelings they have long kept hidden begin to surface, even the coldest hearts slowly begin to heal. Through love, forgiveness, and the courage to understand one another, they discover what it truly means to be a family. Can the scattered pieces of a family finally find their way back to one warm table?

dramas.name: The Affair Was Just the Beginning
dramas.summary: Park Kyung Hee appears to have it all: a thriving interior design business, an adoring social media following, and the perfect family image. To elevate her success, she orchestrates a friendship with her wealthy neighbor, Soo Jung, hoping to leverage Soo Jung's connections into an investment into her business. However, her carefully curated life unravels when she investigates rumors of her husband Lim Jae Hong's infidelity, only to discover him disposing of a dead body – and their daughter is allegedly responsible for the killing. Despite attempting to cover up the incident, they receive an anonymous message that someone has recorded them, forcing Kyung Hee to navigate a treacherous web of blackmail and deceit as they try to put their lives back in order.

dramas.name: Our Happy Days
dramas.summary: Ko Gyeol, a brilliant architect living a flawless life, returns to his hometown after ten years at his grandfather's summons and enters a fierce succession battle within Kangsu Group. As head of Strategic Planning at Kangsu Construction, he relies on cold logic and calculated decisions to seize control. Meanwhile, Cho Eun-ae, a startup developer dreaming of a humane AI-driven world, fights to reclaim her company, Lucky Joy, after it is seized by Kangsu Construction. Their clash over "Joy," the AI at the center of it all, sparks intense rivalry between Gyeol and Eun-ae, but an unexpected incident forces them into an unlikely partnership. Amid conflict and cooperation, they grow closer, navigating a journey to take ownership of their own lives.

dramas.name: Family Register
dramas.summary: Branded as a "mistress' daughter," Na Ji Ni carries lifelong stigma. No Yeong Ju, wrecked by her husband's betrayal, lives with unhealed wounds. Forced under one roof by the man who ruined them both, the two confront buried pain, clashing families, and years of prejudice—fighting to turn bitterness into strength, and maybe into something like family.

dramas.name: Love Penalty
dramas.summary: The relationship that began with suspicion became the most dangerous foul. The story of three people that begins the moment they cross the line they should have stopped at.

dramas.name: Play Me
dramas.summary: The top star Jung Yihyun, who started as a child actor, decides to quit the entertainment industry due to his mother's sudden death. Kang Jaewon, a part-time worker who lives from hand to mouth, has to temporarily give up his actor dream due to real-life pressures. The two, who had a falling-out in high school due to a misunderstanding, reunite years later because of a musical. Through portraying the characters, they rediscover love.

dramas.name: Twisted Tie
dramas.summary: If you cross the line any further, Team Leader... I don't know what I'll do.A romantic and entangled story set in a workplace environment between an employee and his team leader/boss.

dramas.name: Ok, Let's Get Divorced
dramas.summary: A married couple running a wedding dress shop confronts the reality of their exhausting relationship and decide to end their marriage.

dramas.name: Summertime
dramas.summary: Cha Do-hyeon and Yeo Eun-ho are neighbors and best friends who have grown up together, inseparable for 19 years. Eun-ho has always believed they are closer than family, never realizing that Do-hyeon's longtime crush has already gone far beyond friendship. When a transfer student suddenly enters their lives, jealousy and possessiveness push Do-hyeon to lose his composure. As his most familiar friend begins acting strangely, Eun-ho is forced to reconsider what their relationship really means. This summer, will 19 years of feelings finally cross the line?

dramas.name: Summer Fever
dramas.summary: After the cold winter, Yeon Ho and Yu Jun finally welcome a scorching summer

dramas.name: What a Boss Wants
dramas.summary: Kwon Do Hyuk is a brilliant tech visionary and wealthy CEO who seems to have it all, yet he suffers from persistent insomnia and a deep emotional void. After his business partner betrays him and his father tasks him to save a failing entertainment company, Do Hyuk decides to develop an AI-powered entertainer. His search for the perfect muse leads him to the mysterious indie singer "Soo," who bears an uncanny resemblance to his latest AI creation. In reality, "Soo" is Eun Chae, a woman juggling a call center job by day and a vibrant stage persona by night. After several awkward encounters, Do Hyuk uses her secrets as leverage, forcing her into a three-month contract as his secretary. But neither of them expects the line between professional duty and personal attraction to blur.

dramas.name: The Ordinary Jackpot
dramas.summary: Things rarely change, but everything began to change. Eun-tae, who has been working as an ordinary employee, is burnt out from everything that happens to him. Everything from work to relationships with others, his life is filled with boredom. Suddenly, he becomes a lottery winner and gets 1.3 billion won. While it is a huge amount, realistically, it is hard for him to even purchase his own house in Seoul. After reviewing everything, he decides to live his life as he used to, but with a somewhat different mindset, as he has "insurance" that he can depend on.

dramas.name: The Tyrant's Bride-To-Be
dramas.summary: One day, Ha Na wakes up to find herself in the world of a romance novel—as the first fiancée of the male lead. The problem? Her character is a minor one destined to be poisoned at the engagement party of Cheon Nam Ju, heir to the Cheonnam Group. To avoid her tragic fate, Ha Na proposes a contract marriage to Park U Jin, the notorious "tyrant" and acting chairman of the rival Samjeong Group. U Jin accepts the offer, and Ha Na's destiny begins to veer in an unpredictable direction.

dramas.name: The Bedmate Game: Sharehouse
dramas.summary: Ju Yeon subs in on a R-rated dating reality show. Intimate contact is mandatory and bed mate swaps every night! Ex-boyfriend In Ho, nice Jae Hui, and sexy Se Heon is waiting for her in the share house. And their exes start moving in... Participants approach her through a moral-bending rule. Romance vs Money, Instinct vs Reason. Ju Yeon's shaky decision-making begins.

dramas.name: No Crushing Allowed
dramas.summary: No Crushing Allowed follows nineteen-year-olds forbidden to date who find themselves falling in love for the first time, set against the backdrop of two prestigious rival schools — Jinwol Boys' High and Jinwol Girls' High — separated by a single wall. Urban legend has it that whoever hops the wall will pay the price, while the schools' strict policy is clear: get caught dating, and you're expelled. Heartfluttering moments and the thrill of first love unfold alongside the highs and lows of modern-day school life, promising to leave viewers feeling nostalgic and swooning.

dramas.name: Dive into You
dramas.summary: Yun Ha Na is a top actress adored across Asia, living a glamorous life at the height of her career. But after a mysterious accident causes her soul to switch with that of her twin brother, Yun Ha Ru, she suddenly finds herself thrown back into the past. Faced with a second chance to change fate, Ha Na becomes determined to save her first love, Jung U Jae — a former judo prodigy turned bodyguard who once lost his life protecting her. As Ha Na struggles to navigate the past in the midst of unexpected chaos, Ha Ru must cope with waking up in his sister's body, leading to a series of unpredictable and emotional moments. Alongside them is Son Ye Rang, Ha Na's powerful agency CEO and Ha Ru's devoted lover, whose strong exterior hides a deeply vulnerable side. Four young people whose intertwined destinies challenge love, sacrifice, and the possibility of rewriting the past.

dramas.name: Boy, with Caution
dramas.summary: Jang Gi U is a 32-year-old temporary high school teacher. Four years ago, he became the subject of an inappropriate rumor involving a student. As a result, he never took the teacher certification examination and has instead spent the years moving from one contract teaching position to another. Raised in a single-mother household, he grew up constantly hearing that he had to be someone with "no flaws in the eyes of others." He lives as a person who appears flawless, but his life feels dull and unremarkable. At least, that is what everyone says.

dramas.name: Run from Me if You Can
dramas.summary: Hui Won, an ER nurse, transfuses her own blood to save Tae Yeong, a mob boss who arrives with a gunshot wound — only to discover his deadly secret: hemophilia. On the day of her wedding, her fiancé's betrayal leaves her with nothing. Tae Yeong hands her a contract: be his fake wife for one year. With 3 billion won and her father's medical bills on the line, Hui Won is locked away in his mansion. She pushes back against his cold obsession and control, but slowly uncovers the loneliness and warmth hidden beneath his ruthless exterior — and the more she tries to escape, the deeper she falls.

dramas.name: Love in Disguise
dramas.summary: An office romantic comedy that follows the story of a conglomerate heir and his new secretary, a former special forces officer now working undercover. Yun I Jun is a quirky third-generation chaebol raised in a sheltered environment who becomes a prime suspect in the mysterious murder of his previous secretary. When a new "male" secretary arrives to take the position, he has no idea that she's hiding a major secret. To uncover the truth, Kang Jae Hui, a former special forces officer turned police officer renowned as a "human weapon" for her exceptional strength and combat skills, disguises herself as a man and goes undercover as Yun I Jun's personal secretary and bodyguard. While protecting him, she secretly investigates him, setting the stage for unexpected chemistry, hidden identities, and plenty of comedic tension.

dramas.name: A Trap Called Desire
dramas.summary: One accusation destroys an ordinary life overnight. Falsely accused of murder, Ko Eun Seol loses her name, her family, and everything she once called her own. Instead of running, she turns hunter. Eun Seol sets out to reclaim what was stolen from her and confront those who sacrificed innocent lives to protect their own ambitions. As she uncovers one hidden truth after another, the fragile alliances built on greed begin to fracture, and the world sustained by lies starts to collapse. Every truth she reveals brings her closer to the conspiracy that branded her a murderer and closer to those determined to silence her. Can Eun Seol expose the conspiracy behind the life that was stolen from her and finally reclaim it? The perfect lie begins to crumble because of the one woman it failed to erase.

dramas.name: The Table
dramas.summary: Two people sitting across a table, hiding feelings they've never dared to confess.

dramas.name: Eyes on You
dramas.summary: Archery champion Lee Junhyeong reunites with his first love Ahn Siwoo, who was forced to leave six years ago for his sake. He intends to vent his resentment through torment, but when he learns the truth behind his departure, he is overwhelmed with regret and spares no effort to win him back.

dramas.name: Love Hurts
dramas.summary: Do Jin received the worst grades in his class, so his teacher had him to study with Jae Won. Although neither high school student was thrilled about the situation, they gradually came to enjoy each other's company. Eventually, however, they lost touch, yet Do Jin could not forget Jae Won, who had become his first love.

dramas.name: Private Lesson
dramas.summary: College freshman Jae On has harbored a secret crush on his former tutor, Hyeon Seo, for three long years. When Hyeon Seo finally tries to move on from his own painful, unrequited love, Jae On seizes the opportunity to boldly confess his feelings. Terrified that the younger man will suffer the same heartbreak he did, Hyeon Seo desperately pushes him away, but Jae On's relentless and passionate pursuit begins to slowly dismantle his guarded heart.

dramas.name: Make Me Tremble
dramas.summary: Depicts the story of Yeon Su, a woman raised in a conservative household who works at a marketing company and has lived her life while maintaining her chastity, as she meets a man who is the CEO of an adult product company. As their worlds collide, they challenge each other's beliefs and grow together in unexpected ways.

dramas.name: Bad Kid Good Partner
dramas.summary: Top star Yu Il and an unknown actor Hye Seong are forced to play a fake couple after a scandal.

dramas.name: Mission: Mompossible
dramas.summary: Cho Mi Mi has spent her entire life as a devoted mother, raising three children alone while running a humble samgyetang restaurant after her husband's affair. Tired of being the family's sole support system, she finally decides to put her own needs first. However, chaos erupts when all three of her adult children unexpectedly return home. In sharp contrast, Jeon Jin Hui married into a wealthy family and has always prioritized her own desires. The women's paths cross when they learn that their children both work at Jin Hui's fashion company: her son Cha Seung Yun is the chief designer, and Mi Mi's daughter Kang Da Mi is his assistant. While Mi Mi and Jin Hui might seem like they have nothing in common, they both find themselves navigating love, ambition, and the true meaning of motherhood.

dramas.name: Proxy Driver
dramas.summary: Jae-hoon is a timid man who works as a designated driver to make ends meet after being unfairly fired. When he becomes the target of violent exploitation by Jun-hyuk, a drunken team leader at a major corporation, he finds himself trapped in an abnormal relationship marred by power and emotional dependence. Within this toxic cycle, Jae-hoon struggles to reclaim his lost dignity and humanity.

dramas.name: It's You, Regardless
dramas.summary: An unprecedented, unpredictable, and audacious romance that begins 'out of the blue' when a 'melodrama master' actor with a fatal flaw meets a suspicious woman who believes she is the heroine of a drama.

dramas.name: Just Too Bored
dramas.summary: A web-drama depicting office romance that's full of mystery, secrets, and interns trying to navigate through work life.

dramas.name: High School Boy
dramas.summary: Daemun Boys' High School is notorious for bringing together troubled students from across the country. Small and physically vulnerable, Hong Il-tak becomes a constant target of bullying within the all-boys school's rigid social hierarchy. Determined to change his situation, he deliberately approaches Lee Hyun-woo, one of the most influential and popular students on campus. As misunderstandings and ambiguous encounters draw them closer, tension and attraction quietly begin to build. But as their feelings intensify, so do the jealousy, rumors, and pressure surrounding them.

dramas.name: Your Personal Taxi
dramas.summary: There are times when all we want is for someone to truly listen to our story. And sometimes, we come across a song that feels like it's telling that story for us. Welcome to Your Personal Taxi—a special ride where music plays alongside memories, and your story is met with a listening ear. This isn't just any car—it's a personalized classic, and there's something quietly mysterious about it. Passengers with ordinary yet extraordinary lives step in to share personal stories, along with the songs that carry their emotions.

dramas.name: Summer Vacation
dramas.summary: Kim Ha Yeon is an ordinary 18-year-old girl who dreams of a life as dramatic as the ones she sees on screen. Her life takes an unexpected, mystical turn when she heads to the unfamiliar countryside village of Upo-ri for her summer break. There, she crosses paths with Jo Yu Gyeom, the heir to a traditional noble family, and his girlfriend, Sae Ryeong. While he possesses stunning looks and a genius talent for swimming, he lives a colorless existence constrained by old-fashioned rules and repetitive routines. As these two opposites meet in the quiet beauty of Upo-ri, their worlds collide, sparking a transformation in their daily lives and the beginning of a once-in-a-lifetime summer.

dramas.name: The Perfect Lie
dramas.summary: Joonho, a heart surgeon with a perfect smile, and Jisun, a free-spirited teacher-librarian, share a special night after a heart-fluttering date. The next day, they face each other at a police station with completely different memories. One of them is lying. With no evidence or witnesses, even the polygraph result defies expectations, and their mutual suspicion throws their lives into chaos. Questions about Joonho's late wife reveal that the case extends far beyond the two of them. As conflicting testimony and hidden relationships emerge, the truth grows murkier, and one lie sparks a dangerous game in which no one can be trusted.

dramas.name: Shaman Girl and Her Mr. CEO
dramas.summary: Park Seon A, a young shaman who is losing her spiritual powers due to a lack of yang energy, discovers that Lee Jae U, a wheelchair-bound billionaire heir, possesses overwhelming yang energy but suffers greatly because of it.To secure his family's conglomerate and to help Seon A continue her life as a shaman, the two enter into a contract. With his yang energy, Seon A regains the power to perform spells and repeatedly overcomes dangerous situations, while Jae U gradually recovers the use of his legs thanks to her. Together, they defeat Jae U's villainous uncle and Mi Gyeong, Seon A's aunt and a corrupt doctor, before falling in love and choosing to spend the rest of their lives together.

dramas.name: First Doctor
dramas.summary: First Doctor is a medical drama centered on a pediatric surgery unit on the verge of closure, and the people who battle through yet another crisis to protect the most fragile lives.

dramas.name: The Sound of Sugar Cubes
dramas.summary: An orphan, Han Yul didn't have much in life but a dream to become a singer. That is, till he saw his best friend mercilessly murdered by someone he looked up to. Harold. Popular. Perfect. Psychopath. And rich enough to cover his tracks. On the run, Han Yul quits high school, changing his name with every new job he scrambles together. When a famous singer hears his voice and offers a chance at revenge, one question remains: can he sing?

dramas.name: Second Plate
dramas.summary: Kang Yu Hyeon once dreamed of becoming a chef and entered culinary school with complete confidence in his abilities. However, after meeting his exceptionally talented junior, O Min Gyeom, he is forced to confront a level of skill he cannot surpass. Unable to come to terms with the gap between them, Yu Hyeon gives up on his dream and drops out of university. Years later, Yu Hyeon is living an ordinary life as a product developer at a food company. Just when he thinks the past is behind him, he reunites with Min Gyeom, who has become a renowned chef, when the two are assigned to collaborate on the development of a new product.As old wounds resurface and lingering feelings refuse to fade, the reunion challenges both men to face the past they never truly left behind.

dramas.name: Rule 101
dramas.summary: A wealthy professor consumed by sex addiction. A group of students drawn into a forbidden ethical abyss. When a dangerous game of temptation and taboo takes an unexpected turn — a student mysteriously disappears, and everyone believes their secrets will be buried forever. But the arrival of a new face becomes the first domino to fall. The carefully constructed lies, hidden desires, and painful truths of the past begin to unravel, exposing a world of deception and obsession one layer at a time.

dramas.name: Happy Anding
dramas.summary: Asura, a struggling comedy trio made up of Tae-gu, Nam-il, and Jun-seo, who have spent ten years together without recognition. They endured a shabby reality of scant stage income and part-time wages, but after a broadcaster's one-sided taping cancellation, leader Tae-gu declares Asura's breakup. Before them, their feelings jagged and confused, appears a "mysterious suspicious woman" with her face wrapped in a black scarf!

dramas.name: D-100: Marry My Ex to My Bestie
dramas.summary: On her wedding day, Ye Rin is betrayed by her fiancé and best friend and loses her life. In her final moments, she realizes the only man who truly loved her was the one she once rejected. When she wakes up at the moment of the proposal, she chooses revenge—bringing the two together and leading them toward ruin. But as she grows closer to the man she once turned away, her feelings begin to change. Caught between revenge and love, can Ye Rin reclaim everything and find true love?

dramas.name: Sexual Lessons
dramas.summary: After a harsh breakup, Seong-ho seeks skinship lessons to understand what went wrong—only to find his tutor is a man. What begins as a lesson in touch soon turns into something deeper, blurring the lines between teacher and student, friendship and something more.

dramas.name: Walk to Kwangya
dramas.summary: Han So Ran, who doesn't have a single friend in the real world, her only true friend is 'ke-Soran' who lives in Kwangya. One day, she accidentally encounters her ex-boyfriend who broke up with her by ghosting her four years ago, and he was living in the so-called "Analog Mode" as he does not use a smartphone or SNS. The secret that So Ran and ke-So Ran who lives in both Kwangya and the real world that cannot be told to Do Kwang starts to be dug up.

dramas.name: One of a Kind Romance
dramas.summary: One of a Kind Romance follows the story of an ordinary job-seeker whose everyday life is suddenly disrupted by a celebrated actor and a rising idol, leading to a romance brimming with personal desires.

dramas.name: Never Ending Story
dramas.summary: Never Ending Story follows Doyun, a bestselling romance novelist struggling with writer's block for a sequel to his hit book Never Ending Story, who begins working out at a gym and forms a close relationship with a personal trainer named Hyunwoo.

dramas.name: Therapy
dramas.summary: Jung Woogyo, who has lived a long period without sex, enrolls in a four-week confidential sexual therapy program. To his surprise, his therapist is the composed, highly professional—and strikingly fit—Park Heesu. From the awakening of hidden sensitivities to increasingly intense sessions of deep physical connection, Heesu guides Woogyo through unexplored realms of sensation. Each lesson becomes a pulse-racing journey of body and desire. But as the program nears its end, what began as a strictly professional arrangement slowly transforms into an irresistible temptation neither of them can easily walk away from.

dramas.name: Francesca Next Door
dramas.summary: Na Yeong, the vampire transfer student from Romania. Zero social skills, zero common sense, but also zero malice. Although Na Yeong has clear standards and logic, she cannot adapt to the human world and constantly goes astray and causes trouble at school, but upon meeting U Ju, she feels the emotion of a racing heart for the first time. A young vampire who falls in love with a human, and a fellow vampire who stirs her instincts; a sweet yet deadly romance of youths wavering between love and instinct.

dramas.name: Gift
dramas.summary: Depicts the story of professional baseball coach Jung Min Yong, who gains extraordinary abilities after an unexpected accident and takes on the role of head coach for the last-place amateur Deokcheon High School baseball team, leading to a passionate, intense, and tear-jerking season. He gains the power to rate the level and ability of baseball players and scouts Tae Hun as a first-team pitcher, after seeing in him the potential to become a great player. The story unfolds as the players express their dissatisfaction with the newly appointed coach.

dramas.name: The Substitute
dramas.summary: Depicts the story of a high-achieving, low-income student who takes the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) for another person to avoid blackmail. Children are placed on an exam stage where they risk falling behind in life if they do not complete the CSAT safely. To obtain the "score" that will determine their future, a survival CSAT war unfolds thrillingly with betrayals and tricks everywhere. It is expected to expose the dark side of entrance exams unflinchingly through the "unfair" children who search for the correct answer amid extreme dilemmas. Kang Geon Tae, the miracle of a "special low-income scholarship student" who does not lose the top rank at Jeonggyeong High, where wealthy people abound. He drew a perfect blueprint toward the first cornerstone of life, the "prestigious university," but the choices he made to survive return as the only stain. He is a figure who falls into a whirlpool by Nam Jae Yeop's irresistible proposal amid the greatest crisis of his life. Nam Jae Yeop, a hexagon full of a gold spoon background, warm visuals and excellent grades, but everything is a mask. As he begins to deviate from the life plan his father wants, his inferiority toward Kang Geon Tae also intensifies. As cracks start to form in his perfect daily life, he begins to run amok like a grenade with the pin pulled.

dramas.name: Long-Term Relationship
dramas.summary: After ending a long-term relationship, Dojin suddenly breaks up with Jihun without warning. Surrounded by memories of their life together, Jihun spends the next year trying to move on. Eventually, loneliness leads him to download a dating app. What begins as casual conversations with a stranger gradually becomes a source of comfort. Encouraged by their growing connection, Jihun finally agrees to meet in person. But when he opens the door, the person standing there is none other than Dojin.

dramas.name: Deepmate
dramas.summary: An unintended cohabitation between two women— from that moment on, every emotional boundary begins to blur.

dramas.name: Seoul Trip
dramas.summary: On the first day of my trip to Seoul, I chased down a man I mistook for a pickpocket, only to end up spending the night with him. To my horror, I later found my wallet tucked safely in my bag—and discovered he was actually waiting for an "outcall service." The moment I'm forced to pay my debt with my body instead of cash, a disastrous misunderstanding spirals into a dangerous Seoul affair.

dramas.name: Share house
dramas.summary: Yun Su, a new resident from Cheonan, moves into a shared house and tries to hide his identity, but his roommate, Ha Jin, catches him out, sparking a delicate emotional battle. Through punishment dates and casual flirtations, the two move beyond pranks and threats, becoming drawn to each other. However, Ha Jin's sudden departure and public confession spark a conflict, forcing Yun Su to choose between secrecy and honesty.

dramas.name: She Was Never a Good Girl
dramas.summary: Orphaned young, Na Dan Bi is raised under the iron rule of her strict uncle, who molds her life to his desires. Outwardly obedient but fiercely independent inside, she spends a night with Moon Seo Won at her cousin's wedding, hoping his influence can free her from her uncle's control. But when he unexpectedly falls for her, they are both drawn into a perilous web of love, power, and secrets.

dramas.name: Wintertime
dramas.summary: Nine years after their last encounter, Koo Seung Hyeok and Kwon I Hyeon unexpectedly reunite at Nexus, a nightclub linked to organized crime. Seung Hyeok, now the club manager, confronts I Hyeon, who works in lowly conditions, leading to a series of hostile interactions rooted in past grievances. When I Hyeon's father is diagnosed with cancer, he reluctantly re-engages with Seung Hyeok under a work and debt agreement. This forced collaboration ignites complex emotions, as hatred and fixation intertwine. As both men grapple with their tumultuous history—Seung Hyeok's contempt and I Hyeon's struggle with vulnerability—they face the choice between continued conflict or an unforeseen future together.

dramas.name: Beautiful Malice
dramas.summary: A girl from Sichuan, Zhang Zhi'an, moves to South Korea to study abroad and stumbles into an elite chaebol academy — landing in Class F, the lowest tier of the social ladder. Here, everyone lives by a strict code of power drawn along lines of birth and family background, and the whole class is steeped in outright malice. But an airhead is the natural antidote to a schemer: armed with her uniquely Chinese brand of relaxed, unbothered obliviousness, Zhang Zhi'an doesn't just fail to sense the hostility around her — she's far too busy wanting to study to care. Then, one day, she lets slip a glimpse of explosive martial-arts skill that floors the entire class. Slowly but surely, in her own distinctly Chinese way, she begins steering the lost, rebellious students of Class F back toward learning — kicking off a fiery, rule-breaking high-school journey in which she climbs step by step through the academy, turning Class F into a name to be reckoned with.

dramas.name: For Romance, Call the Boss
dramas.summary: Do Hye-ju is a lifelong singleton juggling two jobs — office worker by day, adult web novel writer by night. When her secret serialization gets discovered by director Han Jung-woo, she's fired on the spot. But when the company realizes they can't do without her, Jung-woo offers to rehire her — and this time, Hye-ju holds all the cards. "Director Han, I want you to be my adult scene consultant." And just like that, their steamy coaching sessions begin. There's just one clause in the contract: "If either party develops real feelings, the contract is immediately terminated." But as their demonstrations bring them closer and closer, Hye-ju finds herself growing confused by Jung-woo's advances. Is this just a demonstration — or something real? A romance more dramatic than any novel is about to begin.
